entries.zh:
欢迎来到Stellaris 4.5“天鹅座”守护者更新！

“天鹅座”是一个专注于修复与完善的更新。守护者团队在本周期内集中解决了崩溃和多人游戏不同步的问题，并修复了大家反馈的大量问题。

4.5中包含一项重要的机制改动，它为我们今年晚些时候在“意志力”扩展包中计划的内容做好了铺垫。人口组不再按思潮分裂，因此每个组都是一个混合体，其人口会随着吸引力变化在主导思潮与次要思潮之间漂移。

政策选项卡也经过了重做，改进了排序并新增了教条政策，让你能够更好地控制生成的舰队和恒星基地配置。在帝国创建器中，你还能对帝国地图和舰船颜色进行更多控制。

Stellaris现在原生支持Apple Silicon，因此使用M系列Mac的玩家在此次更新中应能感受到显著的性能提升。

请注意，由于人口组和派系改动的规模，4.5会重置存档和模组兼容性。完整更新日志可通过下方链接查看。

享受更新吧，感谢游玩Stellaris！
entries.en:
Welcome to the Stellaris 4.5 'Cygnus' Custodian update!

Cygnus is an update about repair and refinement. The Custodians spent this cycle closing out crashes, multiplayer desyncs, and fixing a long list of issues you've been reporting.

We have one major mechanical change in 4.5, and it is scaffolding for what we're planning later this year in the Willpower expansion. Pop Groups no longer split by Ethics, so each Group is a blend with its Pops drifting between dominant and secondary ethics as attraction shifts.

The Policies tab has been reworked as well, with improved sorting and new Doctrine Policies to give you better control of your generated fleet and starbase loadouts. You'll also find more control over your empire's map and ship colors in the empire creator.

Stellaris now runs natively on Apple Silicon, so players on M-series Macs should see a significant performance increase with this update.

Please note that 4.5 resets save and mod compatibility due to the scope of the Pop Group and Faction changes. Complete release notes can be found through the link below.

Enjoy the update, and thank you for playing Stellaris!

entries.en:
§HCrisis Type§!
Determines which ['concept_endgame_crisis'] can occur, so long as they are not turned off in the §ICrisis Strength§! setting.

On the §IAll§! setting, they will fire sequentially in random order, with no more than one happening at a given time.
This controls whether the mysterious ['concept_l_gates'] exist.$requires_dis_stars$

entries.zh: §H电脑侵略性§!\n此项设置决定了电脑帝国有多大几率向敌人发动战争，当然也包括了在扩张中总体发动的战争数量。尽管有侵略性设置，在电脑对目标的态度符合判定的情况下他们依然只会选择宣战。
entries.en: §HAI Aggressiveness§!\nThis controls how likely AI Empires are to declare war on their enemies, and thus the overall number of wars that are started over the course of a campaign. Regardless of the aggressiveness setting, the AI will still only declare war if their attitude towards the target permits it.

entries.zh:
§H$DIFFICULTY_ADJUSTED_AI_MODIFIERS$§!
电脑帝国的帝国范围资源产出修正将会与§Y难度§!加成进行乘算。例如，某项科技可以增加£job_miner£矿工岗位的+20%£minerals£$minerals$产出，对['concept_grand_admiral']的电脑帝国而言，开启该选项将变为+40%的修正。

§P警告：§!这将会使末期电脑经济显著变强。
entries.en:
§H$DIFFICULTY_ADJUSTED_AI_MODIFIERS$§!
Empire-wide economic modifiers are multiplied by §YDifficulty§! bonus for AI Empires. For example, a technology which gives +20% £minerals£ $minerals$ from £job_miner£ Miner Jobs will instead give +40% for AI Empires on ['concept_grand_admiral']. 

§PWarning:§! Turning this on makes Late-Game AI economies significantly stronger.

entries.en:
§HDifficulty§!
This controls the game difficulty.

Avaliable difficulty settings are:
- §Y$DIFFICULTY_CIVILIAN$§!: $DIFFICULTY_CIVILIAN_DESC$
- §Y$DIFFICULTY_CADET$§!: $DIFFICULTY_CADET_DESC$
- §Y$DIFFICULTY_ENSIGN$§!: $DIFFICULTY_ENSIGN_DESC$
- §Y$DIFFICULTY_CAPTAIN$§!: $DIFFICULTY_CAPTAIN_DESC$
- §Y$DIFFICULTY_COMMODORE$§!: $DIFFICULTY_COMMODORE_DESC$
- §Y$DIFFICULTY_ADMIRAL$§!: $DIFFICULTY_ADMIRAL_DESC$
- §Y$DIFFICULTY_GRAND_ADMIRAL$§!: $DIFFICULTY_GRAND_ADMIRAL_DESC$

entries.zh: §H铁人模式§!\n铁人模式下禁用控制台作弊，游戏会自动定时保存并覆盖到单个文件中。在游戏中使用此设置开局，将没有回头路可走。
entries.en: §HIronman Mode§!\nIn Ironman mode, console commands are disabled and the game is automatically saved regularly to a single file. In games played with this setting, there is no turning back.

entries.zh: §H电脑帝国数量§!\n 这个选项决定有多少个电脑帝国会在星系中生成。
entries.en: §HNumber of AI Empires§!\nThis controls how many AI Empires will populate the galaxy.

entries.zh: §H初始高级电脑数量§!\n这个选项决定由多少电脑帝国会在开局拥有资源、科技和人口上的优势。除了一个更好的开局它们并没有更多的优势。这个设置不会影响['concept_fallen_empires']。
entries.en: §HNumber of Advanced AI Starts§!\nThis controls how many of the regular AI Empires will start with an initial advantage in resources, technology and population. They do not gain any additional bonuses besides a stronger starting position. This setting does not affect ['concept_fallen_empires'].

entries.zh: §R铁人模式需要Steam云存档，并需要登陆Steam账户。§!
entries.en: §RIronman requires Steam Cloud to be enabled and for the user to be logged into Steam.§!

entries.zh: §R铁人模式下不允许更改存档频率。§!
entries.en: §RYou are not allowed to change autosave frequency when in Ironman mode.§!

entries.zh:
§H星系形状§!
控制星系地图的形状。

部分形状只有在特定的§Y星系尺寸§!下可用。

可用的形状有：
$concept_galaxy_shape_desc$
entries.en:
§HGalaxy Shape§!
This controls the shape of the galaxy map.

Some shapes are only available on certain §YGalaxy Sizes§!.

Avaliable Shapes are:
$concept_galaxy_shape_desc$

entries.zh:
§H星系尺寸§!
控制星系内的恒星系数量，并影响§Y电脑帝国§!的默认数量。

§R警告：§!增大这一选项有可能影响游戏后期的性能表现。
entries.en:
§HGalaxy Size§!
This controls the number of star systems that appear in the galaxy  and affects the default number of §YAI Empires§!.

§RWarning:§! If increased, this setting has significant late game performance implications.
§GAchievements can be earned in this game.§!
§RAchievements can NOT be earned in this game.§!

entries.zh: 使用任何调试命令都将无法获得成就。
entries.en: The use of any debug commands will disable achievements.
§IThis game is not eligible for achievements.§!

entries.zh: §H失落帝国数量§!\n此选项控制星系中中允许生成['concept_fallen_empires']的最大数量。
entries.en: §HNumber of Fallen Empires§!\nThis controls the maximum number of ['concept_fallen_empires'] that are allowed to spawn in the galaxy.

entries.zh: §H最大掠夺者数量§!\n此选项控制星系中中允许生成['concept_marauder_empires', 掠夺者帝国]的最大数量。$requires_apoc$
entries.en: §HNumber of Marauder Empires§!\nThis controls the maximum number of ['concept_marauder_empires', Marauder Empires] that are allowed to spawn in the galaxy.$requires_apoc$

entries.zh: §H随机游牧帝国的数量§!\n该选项控制会有多少随机生成的电脑帝国在开局时为['concept_nomadic_empires', 游牧帝国]。
entries.en: §HNumber of Random Nomadic Empires§!\nThis controls how many randomly-generated AI empires will be ['concept_nomadic_empires', Nomadic Empires] at the start of the game.

entries.zh:
§H宜居星球§!
该选项用于调节处于星系“黄金区域”的星球，也就是宜居星球的产生率。增大该数值会让星系总体上会有更多的宜居星球。即使设置为§Y$FE_HABITABLE_WORLDS_RARE$§!，宜居星球也同样会出现，但只在特定的恒星系中。

§R警告§!将该设置提高到1×以上可能导致游戏后期的性能问题。
entries.en:
§HHabitable Worlds§!
This setting adjusts the chance of a planet existing in the "goldilocks zone" of a solar system, and thus being habitable. Increasing this value results in a galaxy with more habitable worlds overall. On the §Y$FE_HABITABLE_WORLDS_RARE$§! setting, habitable worlds will still appear, but only in special systems.

§RWarning:§! This setting may have late game performance implications if increased above 1x.

entries.zh:
§H资源丰富度§!
该选项用于调节在星系生成的过程中，为天体分配资源矿藏的概率。设置为最低时，资源矿藏仍会出现，但仅存在于特定星系中。

§R警告：§!在调到极高或极低值时可能导致平衡性问题。
entries.en:
§HResource Abundance§!
This setting adjusts the chance for celestial objects to be assigned resource deposits in galaxy generation. On the lowest setting, resource deposits will still appear, but only in special systems.

§RWarning:§! This setting may have balance implications on exceptionally low or high values.

entries.zh: 若选用则会生成随机数量的电脑帝国，最多不超过滑块所设范围。
entries.en: If enabled, a random number of AI Empires will be generated, within the range specified by the slider.

entries.zh: 若选用则会有随机数量的电脑帝国为高级帝国开局，最多不超过滑块所设范围。
entries.en: If enabled, a random number of AI Empires will have advanced starts, within the range specified by the slider.

entries.zh: 若选用则会生成随机数量的失落帝国，最多不超过滑块所设范围。
entries.en: If enabled, a random number of Fallen Empires will be generated, within the range specified by the slider.

entries.zh: 若选用则会生成随机数量的掠夺者帝国，最多不超过滑块所设范围。
entries.en: If enabled, a random number of Marauder Empires will be generated, within the range specified by the slider.

entries.zh: 若选用则会生成随机数量的游牧帝国，最多不超过滑块所设范围。
entries.en: If enabled, a random number of Nomadic Empires will be generated, within the range specified by the slider.

entries.zh: §H开局位置§!\n此选项控制各个帝国的初始星球是集聚在一起，还是被随机投放到宇宙各处中。
entries.en: §HEmpire Placement§!\nThis controls whether empires should spawn in clusters or randomly placed across the galaxy.

entries.zh: §H高级电脑邻居§!\n此选项控制['concept_advanced_empires', 高级电脑帝国]是否可以在玩家附近生成。§Y关闭§!此选项可能导致生成的高级电脑帝国比设定的数值少。
entries.en: §HAdvanced Neighbors§!\nThis controls whether empires with ['concept_advanced_empires', Advanced AI Starts] are permitted to spawn near a player. Having this §YOff§! may result in fewer than the specified number of advanced starts being generated.

entries.zh: §H$FE_MID_GAME$§!\n这个选项可以控制某些中期事件触发的最早年份，比如['concept_machine_uprising']和['concept_great_khan']的崛起。
entries.en: §H$FE_MID_GAME$§!\nThis controls which is the earliest year that mid-game events such as the ['concept_machine_uprising'] and the ['concept_great_khan'] can occur.

entries.zh:
§H$FE_GUARANTEED_COLONIES$§!
该选项控制你的初始星系附近会确保多少颗与你的母星类型相同的星球。

§R警告：§!关闭该选项意味着你的初始星系附近不会有宜居星球。
entries.en:
§H$FE_GUARANTEED_COLONIES$§!
This controls how many habitable planets of the same planet class as your homeworld are guaranteed to spawn close to your starting system.

§RWarning:§! Turning this off may mean you will find no habitable worlds near your homeworld at all.

entries.zh:
§H$FE_VICTORY$§!
此选项决定在没有['concept_endgame_crisis']或['concept_war_in_heaven']存在的情况下，游戏在哪一年可以结束。§I得分§!最高者将会获得胜利。不过此后玩家仍可继续游戏。将滑条拉到最大数值将会关闭胜利计时。

将此滑块设置到最大值将会禁止所有类型的定期胜利。
entries.en:
§H$FE_VICTORY$§!
This controls at which year the game can end, if there is no active ['concept_endgame_crisis'] or ['concept_war_in_heaven']. The empire that has the highest §IScore§! will be declared the winner. It is still possible to keep playing past this year.

Setting this slider to its maximum setting will disable timed victory altogether.

entries.zh: §H$FE_END_GAME$§!\n这个选项可以控制末期事件触发的最早年份，包括['concept_endgame_crises']以及['concept_fallen_empire_awakening']。
entries.en: §H$FE_END_GAME$§!\nThis controls which is the earliest year that end-game events such as ['concept_endgame_crises'] and ['concept_fallen_empire_awakening'] can occur.

entries.zh: §H$FE_TECH_SPEED$§!\n这个选项控制常规帝国获得['concept_technologies']升级的速度。
entries.en: §H$FE_TECH_SPEED$§!\nThis controls how quickly ['concept_technologies'] are gained by regular empires.

entries.zh:
§H$FE_TECH_SPEED_DIFFICULTY_SCALE$§!
该选项控制所选的难度对['concept_technologies']研究花费的影响大小，对高级科技的影响会更大。

提高该数值将进一步提高游戏的困难程度，尤其是在高难度下。
entries.en:
§H$FE_TECH_SPEED_DIFFICULTY_SCALE$§!
This controls how much the selected Difficulty affects the research cost of ['concept_technologies']. This has a greater effect on more advanced technologies.

Increasing this makes the game harder, especially at higher Difficulties.

entries.zh: §H$DIFF_TECH_SCALING_LOW$§!\n提高难度对['concept_technology']花费有小幅度影响。高等级的科技提升的花费比低等级的更甚。
entries.en: §H$DIFF_TECH_SCALING_LOW$§!\nIncreased difficulty has a small effect on ['concept_technology'] costs. Higher tier technologies are increased by more than lower tier technologies.

entries.zh: §H$DIFF_TECH_SCALING_NORMAL$§!\n提高难度对['concept_technology']花费有中等幅度影响。高等级的科技提升的花费比低等级的更甚。
entries.en: §H$DIFF_TECH_SCALING_NORMAL$§!\nIncreased difficulty has a moderate effect on ['concept_technology'] costs. Higher tier technologies are increased by more than lower tier technologies.

entries.zh: §H$DIFF_TECH_SCALING_HIGH$§!\n提高难度对['concept_technology']花费有大幅度影响。高等级的科技提升的花费比低等级的更甚。
entries.en: §H$DIFF_TECH_SCALING_HIGH$§!\nIncreased difficulty has a large effect on ['concept_technology'] costs. Higher tier technologies are increased by more than lower tier technologies.

entries.zh:
§H$DIFF_TECH_SCALING_EXTREME$§!
提高难度对['concept_technology']花费有极大幅度影响。高等级的科技提升的花费比低等级的更甚。

§R警告：§!在高难度设置下，该设置可能会让击败终末危机变得极为困难甚至不可能。
entries.en:
§H$DIFF_TECH_SCALING_EXTREME$§!
Increased difficulty has a very large effect on ['concept_technology'] costs. Higher tier technologies are increased by more than lower tier technologies.

§RWarning:§! At high Difficulty settings, this may make it difficult or even impossible to defeat end-game opponents.

entries.zh: §H$FE_TRADITION_SPEED$§!\n这个选项控制常规帝国获得['concept_traditions']升级的速度。
entries.en: §H$FE_TRADITION_SPEED$§!\nThis controls how quickly ['concept_traditions'] are gained by regular empires.

entries.zh:
§H$FE_NAVAL_CAPACITY_MULT$§!
该选项控制所有帝国的海军容量。会与其他所有海军容量修正进行乘算。

§R警告：§!调高选项可能导致后期游戏性能下降以及出现平衡相关的问题。
entries.en:
§H$FE_NAVAL_CAPACITY_MULT$§!
This multiplies the Naval Capacity of all empires. This is multiplicative with all other Naval Capacity modifiers.

§RWarning:§! This setting may have late game performance and balance implications if increased.

entries.zh:
§H$FE_COMMAND_LIMIT_MULT$§!
该选项控制所有帝国的指挥上限。会与其他所有指挥上限修正进行乘算。

§R警告：§!调高选项可能导致后期游戏性能下降以及出现平衡相关的问题。
entries.en:
§H$FE_COMMAND_LIMIT_MULT$§!
This multiplies the Command Limit of all empires. This is multiplicative with all other Command Limit modifiers.

§RWarning:§! This setting may have balance implications if changed.

entries.zh:
§K危机强度§!
这个选项控制['concept_endgame_crises']的舰队强度。倍数越高就意味着终末危机会变得越危险。

如果§I危机种类§!设置为§I全部§!，则在成功渡过每一个终末危机后会再乘以2。

在§Y$DIFFICULTY_ENSIGN$难度§!及以上，这同样会影响§Y游戏中期危机§!。
entries.en:
§KCrisis Strength§!
This controls the fleet strength of ['concept_endgame_crises']. The higher the multiplier, the more dangerous the end-game crises will be.

If the §ICrisis Type§! setting is set to §IAll§!, this value will be multiplied by 2 for each end-game crisis survived.

On §Y$DIFFICULTY_ENSIGN$ Difficulty§! and above, this will also affect the §YMid-Game Crises§!.

entries.zh: §H失落帝国强度§!\n该选项控制['concept_fallen_empires']和['concept_awakened_empires']的舰队强度。该乘数越高，这些舰队就越危险。
entries.en: §HFallen Empire Strength§!\nThis controls the fleet strength of ['concept_fallen_empires'] and ['concept_awakened_empires']. The higher the multiplier, the more dangerous they will be.

entries.zh: 前超光速文明和未开智物种

§H$FE_PRIMITIVE_WORLDS$§!
这个值控制着['concept_preftl_civilizations']和['concept_presapient_species']在星系中的普遍程度。

数值越高就意味着在星系生成的过程中会创建更多的此类物种。
entries.en:
§H$FE_PRIMITIVE_WORLDS$§!
This controls the prevalence of ['concept_preftl_civilizations'] and ['concept_presapient_species'] in the galaxy.

The higher it is, the more likely these will be created on galaxy generation.

entries.zh:
§H$FE_LOGISTIC_CEILING$§!
当星球的人口增长处于S型曲线的中段时，这一选项控制人口增长能够获得多大的加成。选项越高，人口增长越快。

§R警告：§!调高选项可能导致后期游戏性能下降以及出现平衡相关的问题。
entries.en:
§H$FE_LOGISTIC_CEILING$§!
This controls how large the pop growth bonuses are when planets are in the middle of their logistic curve. The higher it is, the faster pops will grow.

§RWarning:§! This setting may have late game performance and balance implications if increased.

entries.zh:
§H$FE_GROWTH_SCALE$§!
基于帝国人口的数量调节人口增长速率。越高，则人口增长越慢。

§R警告：§!调低这一选项可能导致严重的性能下降以及产生平衡相关的问题，我们高度建议同时也降低§Y$FE_LOGISTIC_CEILING$§!。
entries.en:
§H$FE_GROWTH_SCALE$§!
This scales pop growth based on the number of pops in the empire. The higher it is, the slower pops will grow.

§RWarning:§! Lowering this may have significant performance and balance implications, and decreasing §Y$FE_LOGISTIC_CEILING$§! alongside it is highly recommended.

entries.zh: §H$FE_LOGISTICS_FLEET_UPKEEP$§!\n控制舰队在离港或在敌方国土上时的$r_trade$维护费。改数值提升将在战争中使舰队维护更加昂贵。
entries.en: §H$FE_LOGISTICS_FLEET_UPKEEP$§!\nThis controls the $r_trade$ upkeep of fleets when they are undocked or in enemy territory. Increasing this will make it more expensive to maintain fleets at war.

entries.zh: §H$FE_LOGISTICS_PLANET_DEFICIT$§!\n控制殖民地存在当地赤字时产生的$r_trade$花费。提升该数值会使存在大量资源缺口的特化殖民地变得昂贵，即便帝国中其他的殖民地足以支持其开销。
entries.en: §H$FE_LOGISTICS_PLANET_DEFICIT$§!\nThis controls the $r_trade$ cost to supply colonies with local deficits. Increasing this will make it more expensive to have super-specialized colonies that have large local deficits, even if they are supplied by other colonies in your Empire.

entries.zh: 此派系因为因为被镇压，支持率每月下降$VALUE$。
entries.en: The support of this faction is decreased by $VALUE$ each month due to being suppressed.

entries.zh: $PLANET|Y$拥有$AMT|Y$的$COMBAT_WIDTH$。这是根据行星的大小来计算的，并决定在战斗中能同时造成伤害的军队数量。
entries.en: $PLANET|Y$ has a $COMBAT_WIDTH$ of $AMT|Y$. This is calculated from the size of the planet and determines the number of armies that can deal damage simultaneously during combat.

entries.zh: 该行星已受到$DAMAGE|%Y$损坏。当行星损坏达到§Y100%§!时，一个地块将被摧毁，建筑物会被破坏，并可能杀死地块上的人口。
entries.en: Planet has suffered $DAMAGE|%Y$ damage. When Planetary Damage reaches §Y100%§!, a tile will be devastated, ruining buildings and potentially killing Pops.

entries.zh: §E行星损坏是由于轨道轰炸和行星地面战斗的连带伤害造成的，当行星不再受到轰炸或入侵时它会缓慢修复。§!
entries.en: §EPlanetary Damage is caused by Orbital Bombardment and collateral damage from Ground Combat taking place on the planet. It will slowly be repaired when the planet is not under active bombardment or invasion.§!

entries.zh: 行星正在遭受轰炸，但尚未造成任何损坏。
entries.en: Planet is under bombardment, but has not suffered any damage.
Planet has not been recently bombarded.

entries.zh: 由于当前在轨舰队的轰炸姿态，行星不会遭受进一步破坏。
entries.en: No further damage can be done to the planet with the current bombardment stance of the orbiting fleet.

entries.zh: 从正在进行的地面战来看，行星不会遭受进一步破坏。
entries.en: No further damage can be done to the planet from the ongoing ground combat.

entries.zh: 不能轰炸一个由恒星基地保护的星球。
entries.en: Cannot bombard a planet that is protected by the local Starbase.

entries.zh: 当前的轰炸姿态禁止轰炸不设防的行星。
entries.en: The current bombardment stance of the orbiting fleet prohibits bombarding undefended planets.

entries.zh: 设计图会根据最先进的科技自动生成。
entries.en: Design was automatically generated from latest technology.

entries.zh: 设计图会自动生成，但不会更新。
entries.en: Design was automatically generated but will not update.
Assume direct control of the $SYSTEM$ System.

entries.en: The Sector Management Mode allows us to add and remove systems to this Sector.

entries.zh: 删除星域可以使其中所有的恒星系和行星直接归我方所管辖。同时也会失去所有存储的资源。
entries.en: Deleting the Sector will transfer all systems and planets in it to our direct control. All stockpiled resources will be lost.

entries.zh: 创建新星域后便可以指定一个行星作为星域首府，并可添加自动受其管辖的恒星系。
entries.en: Creating a new Sector allows us to designate a planet as Sector capital and add systems under its automatic control.

entries.en: System is already part of this Sector.

entries.zh: 该恒星系在我们的边境之外。
这个恒星系与该星域不相邻。
entries.en: System is not a neighbor of this Sector.

entries.zh: 帝国首都不能添加至星域。
entries.en: The Empire Capital can not be added to a Sector.

entries.zh: 将这个恒星系从该星域中移除也将导致这个星域失去与其不相连恒星系的控制。请你先移除那些恒星系。
entries.en: Removing this system from the Sector will disconnect other systems. Remove those first.
The $SYSTEM|Y$ System is currently part of the $SECTOR|Y$ Sector.

entries.zh: 这是该星域内储备的能量币，该储备将自动用于维护费消耗。
entries.en: This is the amount of stored Energy Credits in the Sector. It is automatically used for Upkeep.

entries.zh: 这是该星域内储备的矿物，几乎所有的建造都将用到它。
entries.en: This is the amount of stored Minerals in the Sector. It is automatically used for construction.
This is the Capital of our Empire.

entries.zh: 这颗行星与星域首府失去了连接，导致了以下的影响。
entries.en: This planet has no connection to the Sector Capital, causing the following effect.

entries.zh: 这个星球正在遭受饥荒，其带来的负面效应每月都会升级，当前造成以下影响。
entries.en: This planet suffers from starvation, starvation is updated at the start of every month causing the following effects.

entries.zh: 现在不允许改变该舰队的司令。
entries.en: Not allowed to change the leader of this fleet.

entries.zh: 不允许向这支舰队中加入新的舰船。
entries.en: Not allowed to add new ships to this fleet.

entries.zh: 这个文明目前处于石器时代。他们掌握了火，并发展出了基本的口头语言，但我们还没有发现他们有任何冶金或文字交流的证据。
entries.en: This civilization is currently in the equivalent of a Stone Age. They have mastered fire and developed a rudimentary spoken language, but we have yet to see any evidence of metallurgy or written communication.

entries.zh: 这个文明目前处于青铜时代。早期金属冶炼技术和第一批书面语言开始出现，而城市和较大的聚落也初见雏形。
entries.en: This civilization is currently in the equivalent of a Bronze Age. Primitive metalworking and the first written languages have appeared, while cities and larger communities are taking shape.

entries.zh: 这个文明目前处于铁器时代。文明扩张的足迹遍布他们的星球，而钢铁的冶炼和锻造技术使他们有能力制造原始但却有效的工具和武器。
entries.en: This civilization is currently in the equivalent of an Iron Age. They have spread across most of their homeworld, while iron smelting and forging techniques have enabled them to forge crude but effective tools and weaponry.

entries.zh: 这个文明目前处于中古时代后期。他们对金属冶炼技术的掌握愈发娴熟，而印刷机的发明也开始推动知识的传播。
entries.en: This civilization is currently experiencing the equivalent of a Late Medieval Age. They have a firm grasp of metallurgy, and the invention of the printing press has started to benefit the spread of knowledge.

entries.zh: 这个文明目前处于文艺复兴时代。各种科学知识正在以极快的速度被发现，火药的发明也彻底的改变了战争的格局。
entries.en: This civilization is currently experiencing the equivalent of a Renaissance Age. Scientific knowledge is increasing at a rapid rate, and the invention of gunpowder has revolutionized warfare.

entries.zh: 这个文明目前处于蒸汽时代。蒸汽机的发明对他们的社会产生了深远的影响，他们正处于工业革命的风口浪尖上。
entries.en: This civilization is currently in the equivalent of a Steam Age. The invention of the steam engine has had far-reaching effects on their society, and they stand on the cusp of an industrial revolution.

entries.zh: 这个文明已经得以进入工业时代早期。电力和内燃机逐渐被广泛运用，城市化进程突飞猛进。
entries.en: This civilization has advanced into the equivalent of an early Industrial Age. Electricity and internal combustion engines are gradually coming into widespread use, while urbanization increases at a rapid pace.

entries.zh: 这个文明已经进入了机械时代，相当于工业时代后期。他们的工厂实现了消费品和载具的大批量生产，而空中旅行也变得越来越普及。
entries.en: This civilization has advanced into the equivalent of a Machine Age, considered a later part of the Industrial Age. Their factories are mass-producing goods and vehicles, and air travel is becoming commonplace.

entries.zh: 这个文明已经进入了原子时代。他们已经可以使用原子能，但还没有将其运用在太空探索中。他们生产了大量的核武器，足以在一瞬间给整个物种以灭顶之灾。
entries.en: This civilization has advanced into the equivalent of an Atomic Age. They have harnessed the power of the atom, but have not yet made it into space. Nuclear weapons may be prolific, and could result in a sudden extinction event.

entries.zh: 这个文明已经进入太空时代早期。他们已经在自己母星的轨道上布置了早期卫星，也第一次实现了低轨道的载人航天。他们将很快准备好离开他们的星球进入太空。
entries.en: This civilization has entered an Early Space Age. Primitive satellites are orbiting their homeworld, and the first manned space missions have been concluded in low orbit. They will soon be ready to leave their world.

entries.zh: 占领军是指维持占领敌方行星的防御性军队。
entries.en: Garrisons are defensive forces assigned to hold occupied enemy planets.

entries.zh: 进攻部队乘坐自己的运输船并可以登陆殖民地作战。
entries.en: Assault armies come with their own transports and can invade other colonies.

entries.zh: 防御部队十分强大，但是不能移动到其他星球。
entries.en: Defense armies are powerful, but cannot be transported from the planet.

entries.zh: 每个星球都有防御民兵，其规模取决于人口数量。民兵不能被运输。
entries.en: Each planet has a defending Militia, whose size depends on the number of Pops. Militia cannot be transported.

entries.zh: 为了主人而战斗的奴隶士兵，绝大多数都是被迫参加战斗的，但是也有一些奴隶为了获得更多食物或逃离繁重的劳动从而自愿参加战斗。
entries.en: Slave soldiers who serve their masters on the battlefield. Most are conscripted by force, but many slaves volunteer in a desperate attempt to increase their food rations or escape from grueling labor.

entries.zh: 专用克隆人可以在几个月内长成成人。尽管他们的自然寿命不足十年而且缺乏主观能动性，但可以用他们的对长官的绝对忠诚来弥补这些遗憾。
entries.en: Specialized clones that reach adulthood in a matter of months. With a natural lifespan of less than a decade, their lack of personal initiative is deemed an acceptable trade-off for their total obedience to officers.

entries.zh: 专为战斗而存在的冷血机器，它们为了完成任务可以不惜一切代价，不像有机体生物军团一样会受到士气低下的影响。
entries.en: Cold and heartless killing-machines designed only for war. They pursue their objectives relentlessly, and are impervious to the shattering effects of poor morale that so often plague organic combat units.

entries.zh: 灵能调谐的合成人躯体守护着它们的世界，从虚境中汲取决心，这份信念是纯粹的机械单元所无法企及的。
entries.en: Psionically-attuned synthetic frames standing watch over their worlds, drawing resolve from the Shroud with a conviction no purely mechanical unit can match.

entries.zh: 半自动的士兵组成这个加添满了油的战争机器。比起机器人，智能战斗员更灵活，更具侵略性，也能更好地处理各类战场情况。
entries.en: Semi-autonomous cogs in a well-oiled war machine, android combatants are more resilient, aggressive, and responsive to changing battlefield conditions than their robotic predecessors.

entries.zh: 有着灵能能力的部队。他们破坏性的灵能让他们可以在战场使用不一样的战术——他们的首要目标往往是摧毁对方的战斗意志。
entries.en: Soldiers gifted with psionic abilities. Their focus on destructive psionic powers has led to drastically different tactics and strategies on the battlefield - their first objective is always to remove the enemy's willingness to fight.

entries.zh: 成千上万由生物工程设计的有着尖牙厉爪和对杀戮的渴望的饥饿怪兽。一群科学家在远离前线的坚固地堡里监督驱赶着这些暴怒的兽群。
entries.en: Ravenous hordes of bio-engineered horrors made up of little more than teeth, claws and an instinctive urge to kill. A cadre of scientists monitor and supervise the raging swarms as best they can from hardened bunkers behind the front.

entries.zh: 基因改造的超级士兵。从传统的部队里招募精英作为新兵。然后进行基因改造使得他们比原来更大更强更快。
entries.en: Genetically enhanced super soldiers. Recruits are typically chosen from the elite of the conventional military forces. These then undergo extensive gene therapy, and are made larger, stronger and faster than their former peers.

entries.zh: §E军队等级取决于陆军作战的经验水平，更高级的军队在战斗中更有优势。§!
entries.en: §EArmy Rank is determined by the level of combat experience the army has. Higher Rank armies are more effective in combat.§!

entries.zh: §E舰船等级由船员的战斗经验决定。等级越高的舰船战斗效率越高。§!
entries.en: §EShip Rank is determined by the level of combat experience the crew has. Higher Rank ships are more effective in combat.§!

entries.zh: 当人民受到不公正对待时就会产生叛军。
entries.en: Rebels created from Pops which have had enough of unfair treatment.

entries.zh: 由不满的奴隶组成的陆军，他们公开进行武力叛乱希望可以获得独立。
entries.en: Armies comprised of malcontent slaves who have risen up in violent revolt to seize the planet.

entries.zh: 一支土著部队差不多就是一群装备着他们能生产出来的简陋武器的乌合之众。
entries.en: A Primitive Army is little more than disorganized rabble equipped with whatever barbaric arms their world has managed to produce.

entries.zh: 一支工业社会的部队缺乏作为现代陆军的快速反应能力，但至少组织良好。
entries.en: An Industrial Army lacks the dynamic response capabilities of a modern force, but is nominally organized

entries.zh: 按照原始的标准来说，后原子时代的部队装备精良，他们的训练和纪律有时甚至可以击败已进入太空时代文明的军队。
entries.en: A Post-Atomic Army is well-equipped by primitive standards, and their training and discipline may sometimes rival even the hardiest of civilized martial forces.

entries.zh: 统治者的个人精英卫队。
entries.en: The ruler's personal elite guard force.

entries.zh: 统治者的个人精英卫队。
entries.en: The ruler's personal elite guard force.

entries.zh: 一位统治者只能招募一支精英卫队。
entries.en: A ruler may only recruit one personal guard force.

entries.zh: 变种人集群在攻击时是异常残忍的。
entries.en: Mutants are exceptionally relentless in their assault.

entries.zh: 活雪组成了一支令人畏惧的军队，能够冻结其敌人的骨头、甲壳和电路板。
entries.en: Living Snow formed into a formidable force capable of freezing the bones, shells and circuit boards of their foes.

entries.zh: 泰坦巨兽是极其强大的战士。
entries.en: This Titanic Beast is a vastly powerful fighter.

entries.zh: 比泰坦巨兽缺少攻击性，但是作为防御者巨兽护卫依然很强大。
entries.en: While less aggressive than the Titanic Beast, the Titanic Guardian is still a powerful defensive fighter.

entries.zh: 拥有低级智力并且复仇心切的迁徙森林。
entries.en: Vengeful migrating forests possessing rudimentary intelligence.

entries.zh: 这些冷血无情的杀戮机器在叛乱中反抗自己的造物主。他们为了达成目标可以不惜一切代价，不像有机体生物军团一样会受到士气低下的影响。
entries.en: Cold and heartless killing-machines in rebellion against their makers. They pursue their objectives relentlessly, and are impervious to the shattering effects of poor morale that so often plague organic combat units.

entries.zh: 这种直接利用能源的武器会向目标发射激光光束，对中近距离的敌人特别有效。可以无视敌人的装甲，但是会被护盾克制。
entries.en: These directed-energy weapons emit focused laser beams at their targets. They are effective at medium to close range, largely ignoring the bulk of enemy armor.

entries.zh: 物质驱动器能够磁化投射物并朝目标加速射出，虽然说距离有限，但它们的强大动能和射速能够轻易击穿护盾。
entries.en: Mass Drivers that use electromagnetic catapults to accelerate projectiles towards targets at blinding speeds. While somewhat limited in range, their kinetic energy and high rate of fire chew through shields with ease.

entries.zh: 这种深空导弹搭载了核弹头。它们射程极远，但是它们也会被点防御系统轻易拦截。
entries.en: Space-to-space missiles armed with nuclear warheads. Missiles have excellent range, but they are vulnerable to interception by point-defense systems.

entries.zh: 曲速引擎能够在舰船周围生成一层亚空间气泡，使舰船以超光速飞行。虽说这样可以自由选择飞行路线，但是考虑到恒星间的距离，这样移动还是比较慢的。
entries.en: The warp drive generates a subspace bubble around a ship, making faster-than-light speeds attainable. This allows for free but relatively slow travel between stars, given the great distances involved.

entries.zh: 超空间引擎将暂时突破维度限制，令舰船进入超空间。此引擎虽然可以在恒星间快速航行，但其航行自由性受限于现有的超空间航路网络。
entries.en: The hyper drive allows ships to temporarily breach the dimension of hyperspace. Interstellar travel is fast but limited to existing paths along the hyperlane network.

entries.zh: 虫洞生成器将在亚空间建立一条空间隧道来连接空间上的两个坐标点，允许穿越非常远的距离。但是虫洞生成器由于体积过大无法装配在一般舰船上，所以需要一个特殊的虫洞生成空间站来实现旅行。
entries.en: Wormhole generators tunnel through subspace and establish a conduit between two points, permitting travel across vast distances. The large generators are too big to be fitted on ships, requiring special Wormhole Stations to operate.

entries.zh: 一个主要由氢气和氦气以及它们包围着的高密度核心所组成的行星。
entries.en: Gaseous planet with an atmosphere primarily composed of hydrogen and helium surrounding a dense core.

entries.zh: 一颗较大的小行星，处于一大片密集的小行星群中。
entries.en: A larger asteroid or planetoid standing out in the dense cluster of smaller bodies.

entries.zh: 一个被熔化了的星球。它的大气极其稀薄甚至没有大气，由于火山运动，内部的岩浆肆意在地表涌动。这种类型的星球无法维持有机生命的存活。
entries.en: Rocky world that is scorching hot. The atmosphere is thin or non-existent, and lava from the interior flows freely due to constant volcanic eruptions. This type of planet cannot sustain organic life.

entries.zh: 一颗地表上覆盖着厚厚的永冻冰层的岩质星球。极低的温度和非常稀薄的大气令生命难以存活在它的地表上。
entries.en: Rocky world covered in a thick layer of permanently frozen ice. Low temperatures and a very thin atmosphere preclude the existence of life on the surface.

entries.zh: 毁灭于一场大灾难的星球。不管该星球曾经拥有过怎样的财富，都早已灰飞烟灭踪迹难寻了。
entries.en: World devastated by some catastrophic event. Whatever properties it may once have had are no longer discernible.

entries.zh: 荒芜的岩石星球，几乎不存在大气层。表面布满了陨石坑，完全没有生命存在。
entries.en: Barren and rocky world with a thin or non-existent atmosphere. The surface is covered in meteor impact craters and is completely devoid of life.

entries.zh: 荒芜的岩石星球，几乎不存在大气层。表面布满了陨石坑，完全没有生命存在。
entries.en: Barren and rocky world with a thin or non-existent atmosphere. The surface is covered in meteor impact craters and is completely devoid of life.

entries.zh: 干燥的岩石世界，有氮氧大气层，几乎没有大片水体或者降水存在。昼夜温差巨大。很少有植物，但只要有适量降雨就能使沙漠变得生机勃勃。
entries.en: Dry, rocky world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. Precipitation and major bodies of surface water are relatively rare. Significant temperature variations between day and night cycles. Vegetation is scarce, but even moderate precipitation can make the desert bloom.

entries.zh: 干旱的岩石世界，有氮氧大气层，表面多是峭壁和峡谷，可以在气候更加温和的极地地区发现树林，但其它植物比较稀缺。
entries.en: Dry, rocky world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. The dust-covered terrain consists largely of mesas and canyons. Forests can be found in the more temperate polar regions, but vegetation is otherwise scarce.

entries.zh: 一颗寒冷的岩态星球，大气充斥着氮氧元素。除了更温和的赤道地区以外，大部分地表都被永久冻土层覆盖。这里存在一个稳定的生物圈，但植被大多仅限于苔藓和地衣。
entries.en: Cold and rocky world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. Permafrost covers most of the surface except for the more temperate equatorial regions. A stable biosphere exists but vegetation is mostly limited to mosses and lichens.

entries.zh: 有氮氧大气层的岩石世界，存在稳定的水源，有被海洋分割开的大陆，随经纬度不同有不同的季节温度。
entries.en: Rocky world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. Active and stable hydrosphere. Great landmasses are separated by oceans, with large climate variations depending on latitude and precipitation.

entries.zh: 有厚重氮氧大气层的潮湿岩石世界，气候变化巨大，旱季和雨季交替明显。绝大部分的大陆上都覆盖着茂盛的植被。
entries.en: Humid, rocky world with a thick nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. Seasons with significant precipitation are interchanged with drier periods. Most landmasses are covered in dense vegetation.

entries.zh: 有大量水源和氮氧大气层的岩石世界，海洋覆盖了§Y90%§!以上的表面，剩下的陆地均为岛屿。
entries.en: Rocky world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere and a significant hydrosphere. Oceans cover more than §Y90%§! of the surface, with scattered islands making up the remaining percentage.

entries.zh: 主要由极地组成的岩石世界，有氮氧大气层，极地范围很大，冰雪覆盖了大部分的表面，但仍然有四季变化，同时赤道地区也有植被。
entries.en: Frigid, rocky world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. The poles are big, and significant water deposits can be found permanently frozen as glacial ice. However, the planet experiences seasonal variations and the equatorial band is covered by vegetation.

entries.zh: 一个拥有氮氧大气层的山地星球。积雪终年覆盖山顶，山谷点缀着冻结的湖泊。虽然这个行星只有微小的季节变化，但在冻结的湖面底下仍然流动着液态水，并且足以维持一些耐寒植物的日常所需。
entries.en: Mountainous world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. Snow covers the mountaintops, and frozen-over lakes dot the valleys. While the planet experiences minimal seasonal variations, the still-liquid water beneath the frozen surface of the lakes is enough to sustain some hardy vegetation.

entries.zh: 有着氮氧大气层的岩石星球，有大片平原存在。较小的水圈只能支持短暂的雨季。除了几种比较普遍的杂草，其它的植被主要存在于绿洲附近。
entries.en: Rocky world dominated by dry, arid plains covered by a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. The small hydrosphere allows for brief wet seasons, but aside from a few ubiquitous grasses, vegetation is largely concentrated around shallow oases.

entries.zh: 一座人造的深空居所，能提供仿佛行星一般的居住体验，具体而言是指行星上的城市区域。水培农场和先进的过滤科技使其可以几乎长期自持，在居住站上建造的设施则可以开采其环绕的行星上的资源。
entries.en: An artificial deep-space arcology offering planet-like - if decidedly urban - living conditions. Hydroponics and advanced filtering technologies make it near-self-sustaining, and station-borne facilities can mine the station's host planet for raw materials.

entries.zh: 有剧毒大气层的岩石世界，任何高级生命体都无法生存。
entries.en: A rocky planet with a thick atmosphere that is lethal to all known higher forms of life.

entries.zh: 我们的探测器不能穿透围绕在这个行星周围的迷雾。进入迷雾的舰船有去无回。
entries.en: Our sensors are unable to penetrate the thick fog surrounding the planet. Ships that enter it do not return.

entries.zh: 体积庞大的B型主序星大多星等极低而且泛蓝。虽然这种恒星比较罕见，但B型恒星的亮度使他们在夜空中脱颖而出。
entries.en: The large class B main-sequence stars are very bright and blue. Although somewhat rare, the luminosity of these stars make them among the most visible to the naked eye.

entries.zh: 这些相对年轻的白色或青白色的主序星通常是肉眼观测中最引人注目的。它们体积巨大并且自转飞速，但最终会演变成慢速的低温的红巨星。
entries.en: These relatively young white or bluish-white main-sequence stars are typically among the most visible to the naked eye. They are large and rotate very quickly, but will eventually evolve into slower and cooler red giants.

entries.zh: F型恒星的体积是相当大的，通常被称为黄白矮星。虽然他们经常发射出大量的紫外线辐射，但它们的广泛的宜居带为生命的存在提供了一个很好的机会。
entries.en: F-type stars are fairly large and often referred to as yellow-white dwarfs. Although they often emit significant amounts of UV radiation, their wide habitable zones have a good chance of supporting life-bearing worlds.

entries.zh: G型恒星通常被称为黄矮星，实际上G型恒星的颜色范围是从白色到微黄色。主序星在演变成红巨星前，往往先需要聚变约100亿年。虽然它们的寿命短于K型恒星，但G型恒星往往被认为更加适合生命的存在。
entries.en: Often referred to as yellow dwarfs, G-type stars actually range in color from white to slightly yellow. Main-sequence stars fuse hydrogen for roughly 10 billion years before they expand and become red giants. Although their lifespans are shorter than K-type stars, worlds inside the habitable zone of a G star often enjoy optimal conditions for the development of life.

entries.zh: 这些主序星通常被称作橙矮星，它们在宇宙中非常普遍。它们可以在主序星列中至少存在三百亿年，这意味着K型恒星的行星上的生命可以拥有一个非常漫长又安稳的进化过程。
entries.en: These main-sequence stars, sometimes referred to as orange dwarfs, are a fairly common sight. They are stable on the main-sequence for up to 30 billion years, meaning that worlds orbiting a K-type star have a longer than average window to evolve life.

entries.zh: 宇宙中最为普遍存在的恒星类型，往往被称为红矮星。它们的亮度很低，这意味着它们很难被肉眼观察到。尽管他们拥有非常长的寿命，很少发射出紫外线的红矮星对大多数生命的维持和居住是不利的。
entries.en: The most common stars in the universe, often referred to as red dwarfs. Their low luminosity means they are difficult to observe with the naked eye from afar. Although they typically have an extremely long lifespan, red dwarfs emit almost no UV light resulting in unfavorable conditions for most forms of life.

entries.zh: 褐矮星是缺乏足够大质量来维持氢融合反应的次恒星。尽管尺寸上和气态巨行星相差无几，但其密度要远大于后者。由于光强较弱且产生热量很少，褐矮星几乎无法给环绕它的行星提供维持生命必须的环境。
entries.en: Brown dwarfs are substellar objects that lack the mass to sustain hydrogen fusion. Roughly the size of large gas giants, they have a much greater density. Their low luminosity and comparatively small heat generation means that planets orbiting them are unlikely to support life.

entries.zh: 红巨星拥有极大的半径和相对较低的表面温度，是拥有适中质量的恒星演化到衰变期时的形态。红巨星膨胀的大气层和强烈的光强可能会形成距离红巨星十分遥远的宜居带。
entries.en: With a large radius and comparatively low surface temperature, red giants are stars of moderate mass in a late stage of stellar evolution. Their expanded stellar atmospheres and high luminosity make for distant habitable zone orbits.

entries.zh: 黑洞通常是由非常大质量的恒星在其寿命周期结束时坍塌而形成的，黑洞具有极强的重力场，能够阻止一切事物——包括光——逃逸出其视界边界。黑洞发出的引力波会干扰超光速引擎的工作，使战舰难以紧急脱离战斗。
entries.en: Typically formed as a result of the collapse of a very massive star at the end of its life cycle, black holes have extremely strong gravity fields that prevent anything - including light - from escaping once the event horizon has been crossed. The gravitational waves emitted by black holes interfere with FTL drives, making it harder for ships to escape from combat.

entries.zh: 一些大质量恒星在迅速坍缩并爆炸成为超新星时，会产生这些令人难以置信的恒星残骸，虽然它们的直径通常只有十公里，但它们的质量比一般的G型恒星大了很多倍。中子星所发出的引力波和辐射使得船员们在经过时必须谨慎导航，从而导致了船只在经过该区域时的亚光速航行速度显著降低。
entries.en: These incredibly dense stellar remnants are sometimes created when a massive star suffers a rapid collapse and explodes in a supernova. Although their diameter is typically as little as ten kilometers, their mass is many times greater than an average G-type star. The gravitational waves and radiation emitted by neutron stars must be carefully navigated around, slowing the sublight speed of ships.

entries.zh: 脉冲星是能够发射电磁辐射的高度磁化的中子星。当恒星高速旋转时，辐射束仅在其轴线直接指向观察者时才可见。该现象产生了一个非常精确的脉冲间隔，这种脉冲有时非常精确，可以用来精确测量时间的流逝。脉冲星发射的辐射会干扰护盾偏转器技术，导致船舶和地面护盾无法使用。
entries.en: Pulsars are highly magnetized neutron stars that emit beams of electromagnetic radiation. As the star rotates, the radiation beam is only visible when it is pointing directly at the observer. This results in a very precise interval of pulses, which sometimes is so exact that it can be used to measure the passage of time with extreme accuracy. The radiation emitted by pulsars interferes with deflector technology, rendering ship and station shields inoperable.

entries.zh: 数千年与毒性神衹的接触导致这颗恒星的构成发生了变化。它曾是一颗相当标准的G型恒星，但现在它散发出一种与星系系其他地方不同的怪异绿色薄雾。
entries.en: Millennia of exposure to the Toxic Entity have caused alterations in the makeup of this star. Though once it was a fairly standard G-type star, now it emits an eerie green haze unlike any seen elsewhere in the galaxy.

entries.zh: 生物侵蚀体覆盖了该星球的表层。
entries.en: The surface of this world is covered by some kind of biological contaminant.

entries.zh: 该世界拥有氮氧大气层，生态系统可以自我修复，各个纬度对于高级生命体来说都是极佳的生存空间。
entries.en: An ideal, temperate world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere and a resilient ecosystem. Optimal conditions for all known higher forms of life at different latitudes.

entries.zh: 一颗大气中充斥着氮氧元素的岩态行星。目前它正处于核冬天，大气中含有乌黑浓厚的悬浮颗粒。表面辐射水平高。鲜有生命迹象。
entries.en: A rocky world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. It is currently experiencing a nuclear winter, with dense layers of sooty aerosols in the atmosphere. High levels of surface radiation. Minimal signs of life.

entries.zh: 该巨型环带是环形世界的一部分，它环绕着恒星系中的恒星。\n不像球形行星那样拥有诸多限制，内圈有大量人造宜居空间。
entries.en: Part of a Ring World, an immense band encircling the system's sun.\nBuilt to allow for numerous artificial habitation zones along its inner span, freed from the restrictions and mundanity of planet-bound, spherical existence.

entries.zh: 该巨型环带是环形世界的一部分，它环绕着恒星系中的恒星。\n不像球形行星那样拥有诸多限制，内圈有大量人造宜居空间。
entries.en: Part of a Ring World, an immense band encircling the system's sun.\nBuilt to allow for numerous artificial habitation zones along its inner span, freed from the restrictions and mundanity of planet-bound, spherical existence.

entries.zh: 该巨型环带是环形世界的一部分，它环绕着恒星系中的恒星。\n不像球形行星那样拥有诸多限制，内圈有大量人造宜居空间。
entries.en: Part of a Ring World, an immense band encircling the system's sun.\nBuilt to allow for numerous artificial habitation zones along its inner span, freed from the restrictions and mundanity of planet-bound, spherical existence.

entries.zh: 一个绕恒星公转的巨大的环状人造星体，也是环形世界的一部分。\n这片巨型结构的区段存在着不可弥补的损害。
entries.en: Part of a Ring World, an immense band encircling the system's sun.\nThis section of the megastructure appears irreparably damaged.

entries.zh: 一个绕恒星公转的巨大的环状人造星体，也是环形世界的一部分。\n这片巨型结构的区段存在着不可弥补的损害。
entries.en: Part of a Ring World, an immense band encircling the system's sun.\nThis section of the megastructure appears irreparably damaged.

entries.zh: 一个绕恒星公转的巨大的环状人造星体，也是环形世界的一部分。\n这片巨型结构的区段存在着不可弥补的损害。
entries.en: Part of a Ring World, an immense band encircling the system's sun.\nThis section of the megastructure appears irreparably damaged.

entries.zh: 整个星球被某种无法穿透的能量屏障封闭了。这个屏障屏蔽了对其地表进行的任何扫描。
entries.en: This entire world is encased in some kind of impenetrable energy barrier. It blocks all scans of the surface.

entries.zh: 一颗地表覆盖着人造建筑的岩态星球。稀薄的大气主要由工业污染物组成。巨量的能源从整个星球的地表排放出来，但是没有任何有机生命体的反应。
entries.en: Rocky world covered with artificial structures. The thin atmosphere consists mostly of industrial pollutants. There are strong energy emissions coming from across the entire surface, but no organic life signs.

entries.zh: 覆盖着人造结构的岩石星球，稀薄的大气层中充斥着工业废气，有机生命体根本无法生存。
entries.en: Rocky world covered with artificial structures. The thin atmosphere consists mostly of industrial pollutants and is not capable of supporting biological life.

entries.zh: 这整个世界其实就是一个巨大的生物体，由蜂巢思维通过灵能所操纵。任何不属于蜂巢意识体的生物一旦进入该世界将会受到整个行星的攻击。
entries.en: This entire world is a giant living organism, psionically connected with the Hive Mind that shaped it. Any beings not part of the Hive that set foot here will be attacked by the very terrain itself.

entries.zh: 曾经是一颗星球的焦黑残骸。一股巨大的能源波动引爆了这颗星球的核心，只剩下了漂浮的石块。
entries.en: The charred, broken remnants of what was once a planet. A massive energy surge has detonated this world's core, leaving only drifting slabs of rock.

entries.zh: 一颗巨大的小行星，主要由结冰的水分子所构成。
entries.en: A larger asteroid or planetoid composed primarily of frozen H2O.

entries.zh: 一个绕恒星公转的巨大的环状人造星体，也是一个环形世界的一部分。\n这个巨型结构的这片区段存在着严重损伤 ——尤其是一些先进区划——但这并非无法修复。
entries.en: Part of a Ring World, an immense band encircling the system's sun.\nThis section of the megastructure has sustained damage - especially to some of its more advanced districts - but it does not appear irreparable.

entries.zh: 植被多样的地貌，气候温和。
entries.en: Diverse forested terrain with a mild climate.

entries.zh: 贫瘠干燥的地貌，偶有岩石。
entries.en: Barren and dry terrain with occasional rocky outcroppings.

entries.zh: 干旱多岩的地貌，植被稀疏
entries.en: Dry and rocky terrain with sparse vegetation.

entries.zh: 寒冷风啸的草原，植被稀疏。
entries.en: Cold and wind-swept steppes with sparse vegetation.

entries.zh: 有大量植被覆盖的地貌，气候温和湿润。
entries.en: Vegetation-covered terrain with a warm and humid climate.

entries.zh: 独岛群礁的地貌，海洋环抱。
entries.en: Isolated islands and archipelagos surrounded by ocean.

entries.zh: 冰雪覆盖的地貌，寸草不生。
entries.en: Snow- and ice-covered terrain with no vegetation.

entries.zh: 树木和灌木在温暖，干燥的地貌上面稀稀拉拉的生长着。
entries.en: Warm, dry terrain with widely spaced trees and shrubs.

entries.zh: 被积雪常年覆盖的地貌。
entries.en: Elevated terrain covered in snow and ice.

entries.zh: 生物群落多样化的地貌，非常适合大多数生命形式。
entries.en: Diverse terrain with biomes that are eminently suitable to most forms of life.

entries.zh: 恶劣，饱受战争蹂躏的地貌。辐射水平足够低到可以支持一些生命存在。
entries.en: Harsh, war-torn terrain. Radiation levels are low enough to support some life.

entries.zh: 被索林虫群的分泌物污染过的地貌。
entries.en: Terrain despoiled by the Prethoryn swarm's secretions.

entries.zh: 由环形世界的内部系统精心维护的处女地。
entries.en: Pristine terrain carefully maintained by the Ring World's internal systems.

entries.zh: 极净无菌地带，遮蔽着地下的超导晶格。
entries.en: Sterilized terrain shielding sub-surface superconducting lattices.

entries.zh: 人造重力生成器上加工的矿物板，作为城市和工业建造的预置的地基。
entries.en: Wrought mineral plates over artificial gravity generators act as ready-made foundations for urban and industrial construction.

entries.zh: 一大片高耸险峻的山脉横跨此区域。
entries.en: A vast range of tall and impassable mountains stretches across this region.

entries.zh: 此区域有一座活火山，喷发着岩浆和火山气体。
entries.en: There is an active volcano in this region, spewing forth lava and volcanic gases.

entries.zh: 此区域的野生动物异常致命，其中不乏危险掠食动物和剧毒植物。
entries.en: The wildlife in this region is particularly lethal, with many dangerous predators and poisonous plants.

entries.zh: 这整个区域完全长满了厚厚的、不可穿越的丛林。
entries.en: This entire region is completely overgrown with thick, impassable jungle.

entries.zh: 大量的流沙覆盖该区域，在此建设是不可能的。
entries.en: A vast body of quicksand covers this region, making construction impossible.

entries.zh: 危险的沼泽地，氤氲着腐臭气体。
entries.en: Treacherous swamplands and bogs surrounded by putrid gases.

entries.zh: 此区域被一座庞大的冰川覆盖。
entries.en: An immense body of dense ice covers this region.

entries.zh: 在这一地区，一种对大部分生命有毒的海藻如茂密的森林般覆盖着海洋。
entries.en: A thick forest of kelp that is toxic to most forms of life covers the ocean in this region.

entries.zh: 此区域的绝大部分被一个巨大的深坑占据。
entries.en: A colossal sinkhole covers most of this region.

entries.zh: 这里曾经是一座宏伟壮观的城市，如今只是个无边无际的金属垃圾场。
entries.en: Once a great city, now just a metal boneyard stretching as far as the eye can see.

entries.zh: §L这里曾经有一座由高度发达科技建造的大都市，在被遗弃数个世纪后，这里只剩下废墟和碎石。§!
entries.en: §LOnce a great city built with highly advanced technology, now just ruins and rubble that has been abandoned for centuries.§!

entries.zh: §L一座半毁坏的巨大设施，装有数百万个停滞舱。设施没有通电，而舱内保存的有机生物也只残留了少许有机质，显示出他们似乎原本来自数十个不同的有机物种。§!
entries.en: §LA sprawling, partially ruined complex containing millions of stasis chambers. The complex is unpowered and only trace biomatter remains of the chambers' occupants, who appear to have come from dozens of distinct biological species.§!

entries.zh: 整块地区被单独划分出来，作为当地前超光速原住民的保留地。
entries.en: This entire region has been set aside as a reservation for the pre-FTL indigenous population.

entries.zh: 这块地区已被划分为濒危的外星物种保护区。
entries.en: This entire region has been set aside as a reservation for endangered alien species.

entries.zh: 这个世界的迁徙森林频繁集体迁移到新的地区，破坏建设好的道路，输电线路和其他基础设施。
entries.en: The mobile forests of this world frequently migrate en masse to new regions, disrupting efforts at building roads, power lines and other infrastructure.

entries.zh: §Y增加相邻地块的£society£ 研究。§!\n\n覆盖迁徙林木生态圈的大片自然保护区。
entries.en: §YAdds £society£ Research to neighboring tiles.§!\n\nA nature reserve that covers the vast expanse of territory where the wandering forests range.

entries.zh: 通往地下洞穴网络的巨大洞口，里面的洞穴纵横交错，贯通整个星球。
entries.en: A large hole in the ground that leads into the extensive cave network stretching beneath the surface of this world.

entries.zh: 某物体撞击了这颗星球的表面，形成了该巨大的撞击坑。
entries.en: Something collided with the surface of this world at some point, creating this massive impact crater.

entries.zh: 这巨大的弹坑是由一个极具毁灭性的氢弹爆炸造成的。
entries.en: This massive crater was created by the detonation of a particularly devastating hydrogen bomb.

entries.zh: 该区域在残酷无情的轨道轰炸下遍地覆盖着无数的弹坑。
entries.en: This region is covered by countless craters caused by relentless Orbital Bombardment.

entries.zh: 在这片荒凉的、受过辐射的废土上，几乎没有生物能存活下来。
entries.en: Few organisms can survive in this desolate, irradiated wasteland.

entries.zh: 这片区域充斥着大量废弃的工业建筑与含有剧毒的土壤，都是旧时代的遗物。
entries.en: This region is covered by ruined industrial complexes and toxic soil; detritus from a past age of progress.

entries.zh: 某个遗落文明的断壁残垣，先于我们居住在此地。
entries.en: The ruins of a forgotten civilization that lived here before us.

entries.zh: 这片区域被大片贫民窟占据，里面住满了穷人与流浪者。
entries.en: This region is covered by vast shanty towns and slums filled with the poor and the outcast.

entries.zh: 许多巨型外星生物在这里安家，避开它们才是明智选择。
entries.en: Numerous Titanic aliens make this area their home, it would be wise to avoid it.

entries.zh: 这片区域被轨道轰炸夷为平地。
entries.en: The area has been devastated by orbital bombardment.

entries.zh: 这片区域被一系列大规模地面战斗摧毁了。
entries.en: The area has been devastated by a series of massive ground battles.

entries.zh: 这片废墟曾是座大城市，现在只有零星的拾荒者们在此苟且偷生。
entries.en: A scattered population of scavengers are eking out a desperate existence in the ruins of this once major city.

entries.zh: 这片区域曾遭到大量核弹头袭击。尽管其辐射量与爆炸时相比已经减少了许多，但仍需要展开大规模清理才可居住。
entries.en: A region that was the target of numerous nuclear warheads. Though the radiation in this area has gone down since the initial impact, it is still unfit for habitation barring a major clean-up effort.

entries.zh: 这是曾存在于行星上的大型人口中心遗留下的摇摇欲坠的废墟，原本的居民已消失得无影无踪。
entries.en: The crumbling remains of what must once have been a major population center on the planet. No traces of its past inhabitants remain.

entries.zh: 这片焦黑并充满辐射的废墟曾经是一座有机生物的大都市。仍未倒下的那些建筑里现在也只剩下灰烬了。
entries.en: The charred and irradiated ruins of what was once a major organic population center. Those buildings that still remain standing contain nothing but ashes now.

entries.zh: 那些选择自我终结而非被同化的有机生物的腐烂尸体充盈着这个曾经是主要定居点的破碎废墟。
entries.en: This once major settlement is now a crumbling ruin, occupied only by the decaying bodies of those organics that chose self-termination rather than be assimilated.

entries.zh: 无数烧焦的战争机器，以及有机生物战士们的骸骨遍布于这片曾经的战场上。残余的辐射会对大部分电子设备造成干扰。
entries.en: Tens of thousands of burnt war machines and the twisted skeletal remains of organic soldiers litter the ground at this former battlefield. Residual pockets of radiation interferes with most electronics.

entries.zh: 这一区域在过去经历了高强度的露天开采，当时负责开采的原始陈旧机器未将该地区未来的发展纳入考虑范畴。
entries.en: This area was heavily strip mined in the past, by older and more primitive machine models that unfortunately were not programmed to take future development of the region into account.

entries.zh: 在这颗星球上，一小群有机生物社会仍存在于机械管理之外。暴力、疾病和饥荒在居住地的高墙内肆虐，其居民的科技水平已经倒退了数个世纪。
entries.en: A pocket of organic society on this world that still exists outside of machine supervision. Violence, disease and starvation run rampant inside the settlement's walls, whose inhabitants have regressed technologically by several centuries.

entries.zh: 这里曾经有着蜂巢居住的复杂地下隧道系统，但因对当地资源与野生动物的过度开发而被遗弃了。
entries.en: This site once housed extensive underground tunnel systems inhabited by the Hive, but was abandoned due to overexploitation of local resources and wildlife.

entries.zh: 大量废墟使这片区域无法通行。
突出地表且品位极高的精矿，其中似乎有若干一动不动的石质生物。
entries.en: Incredibly rich outcroppings of minerals that seem to be comprised of petrified lithoids.

entries.zh: 一片满是自然美景的区域，此地被设为自然保护区永远不能被打扰。
entries.en: A section of this world has been declared a nature preserve and may never be tampered with.

一个原始的亚光速空间探测器，似乎已有几百年历史。能源早已枯竭。
entries.en: A primitive sublight space probe that appears to be several centuries old. Its power supply has long since been depleted.

entries.en: The arkship Hyacinth drifts slowly above this world in a stable orbit.

entries.en: §LMembers of this species have a special charisma, and are generally considered pleasant to be around.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种的外貌与行为习惯往往令其他生物感到反感，只有少部分生物愿意与它们打交道。§!\n
entries.en: §LThe physical appearance and customs of this species are considered offensive to most others, and few appreciate them as neighbors.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种拥有与生俱来的天赋。§!\n
entries.en: §LMember of this species are born with a natural aptitude.§!\n

entries.en: §LMembers of this species possess great physical strength, making them formidable fighters on the ground.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种的肢体力量几乎强大到可以颠覆物理法则。§!\n
entries.en: §LMembers of this species possess a strength that almost defies the laws of physics.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种的肉体比一般生物要弱小，使他们无法成为优秀的战士。§!\n
entries.en: §LMembers of this species are physically weaker than average, making them poor fighters on the ground.§!\n

entries.zh: 这个物种的个体可以承受能将大多生物杀死的创伤。\n
entries.en: Members of this species are capable of withstanding physical trauma that would kill most other beings.\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种相当脆弱，一点小伤都能要了他们的命。§!\n
entries.en: §LMembers of this species are particularly frail - what would be a minor injury to others can often be fatal to them.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种的内心十分强大，在面对危险时他们很少惊慌失措。§!\n
entries.en: §LMembers of this species possess great mental discipline, rarely panicking when faced with a dangerous situation.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种会尽可能的回避身体上的对峙，并且很容易惊慌失措。§!\n
entries.en: §LMembers of this species tend to shy away from physical confrontations and are quick to panic.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种一般都不愿意辛勤劳动，往往不愿挪动自己。§!\n
entries.en: §LMembers of this species shy away from hard labor, and generally refrain from exerting themselves.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种拥有很高的集群社会性，它们很乐意与其他生物生活在一起。§!\n
entries.en: §LMembers of this species are highly communal, and quite used to living in close proximity to others.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种在拥挤的社会环境下会变得暴躁，它们喜欢一个人呆着。§!\n
entries.en: §LMembers of this species tend to be solitary and territorial, often becoming agitated in crowded conditions.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种可以很好地适应一个陌生的环境。§!\n
entries.en: §LThis species is highly adaptive when it comes to foreign environments.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种几乎可以接受任何环境。§!\n
entries.en: §LThis species is remarkably adept at adapting to any foreign environments.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种难以适应陌生的环境。§!\n
entries.en: §LThis species does not adapt well to foreign environments.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种有一个四海为家的进化史，它们对迁徙和扩张习以为常。§!\n
entries.en: §LThis species has a nomadic past, and its members often think nothing of relocating to another world.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种有一段安土重迁的过往，其人口十分不愿迁离成长的地方。§!\n
entries.en: §LThis species has a sedentary past, and its members are reluctant to migrate away from where they grew up.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种天性节俭，总是喜欢尽一切可能将利益最大化。§!\n
entries.en: §LThis species is instinctively economical and is always looking to make a good profit, whatever corners need cutting.§!\n

entries.zh: §L该物种头脑灵活，善于打破陈规，他们懂得如何最大化利用其基础设施和电力网。§!\n
entries.en: §LMembers of this species are good at 'thinking outside the box' and know how to maximize the efficiency of their infrastructure and power grids.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种非常吃苦耐劳，总是试着超越自我努力的极限。§!\n
entries.en: §LMembers of this species are known for their diligent and hard-working nature, always going above and beyond.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种对工程学和材料科学有着天然的兴趣。§!\n
entries.en: §LMembers of this species have a natural inclination towards engineering and material sciences.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种对工程学的基本概念一窍不通。§!\n
entries.en: §LMembers of this species have a hard time grasping many of the fundamental concepts of engineering.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种对理论物理和天文现象有着天然的兴趣。§!\n
entries.en: §LMembers of this species have a natural inclination towards theoretical physics and astral phenomena.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种对理论物理的基本概念一窍不通。§!\n
entries.en: §LMembers of this species have a hard time grasping many of the fundamental concepts of theoretical physics.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种对社会学和生物科学有着天然的兴趣。§!\n
entries.en: §LMembers of this species have a natural inclination towards sociology and biological studies.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种对社会学科的基本概念一窍不通。§!\n
entries.en: §LMembers of this species have a hard time grasping many of the fundamental concepts of sociology.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种善于从自身经历中学到知识。§!\n
entries.en: §LMembers of this species are quick to learn from their experiences.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种不太善于从自身经历中学到知识。§!\n
entries.en: §LMembers of this species are slow to learn from their experiences.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种比其他生物活的更长。§!\n
entries.en: §LThe natural lifespan of this species is longer than average.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种比其他生物活的更短。§!\n
entries.en: §LThe natural lifespan of this species is shorter than average.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种是从仅有直觉和基础情绪的状态中提升而来。他们现在身负智慧，就必须去学会驾驭自由意志。§!\n
entries.en: §LThis species was uplifted from an existence of instinct and base emotion. Now burdened with sapience, they must learn to navigate free will.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种对星辰大海总有一种根深蒂固的向往。§!\n
entries.en: §LThis species has always, consciously or not, longed to traverse the void between the stars.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种对他们称之为家园的星球寸土不让。§!\n
entries.en: §LMembers of this species are very possessive of the planets they call home.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种比其他生物更加贤明。§!\n
entries.en: §LMembers of this species are more philosophically inclined than most.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种将对哲思的向往被彻底封杀在了传统的体力劳动中。§!\n
entries.en: §LThis species has traditionally shunned intellectual pursuits in favor of physical labor.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种与一个更先进的社会共同进化。尽管一开始并非刻意，但对生理与心理的选择性育种使他们成为了卑躬屈膝的奴仆。§!
entries.en: §LThis species evolved alongside a second, more advanced civilization. Never particularly intelligent to begin with, selective breeding for physical prowess and docility has reduced them to servile proles.§!

entries.zh: §L这个物种相对新的事物往往更愿意相信老的经验。§!\n
entries.en: §LMembers of this species often prefer old wisdom over new experiences.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种能够在强辐射中茁壮成长。§!
entries.en: §LThis species has evolved to thrive in environments subject to extremely high levels of background radiation.§!

entries.zh: §L这个特质将令您的领袖拥有更长的寿命。§!\n
entries.en: §LThis trait increases the average life span of leaders.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种乐于寻求共识，并且更希望遵从主流的思想观念。§!\n
entries.en: §LThese people always seek consensus and are more likely to conform to the governing ethics.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种天生反骨，会不断尝试挑战现状。§!\n
entries.en: §LThese people are rebellious in nature and constantly try to challenge the status-quo.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种的寿命令人惊讶地长。§!\n
entries.en: §LLifespans in this species are unusually long.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这种生物能够长寿到因年龄而获得他人的敬重。§!\n
entries.en: §LThis species can grow to an age that commands dignity and respect.§!\n

entries.zh: §L对于这个物种来说，时光就如白驹过隙。他们无法延长寿命的长度，因此决定拓展生命的广度。§!\n
entries.en: §LTime is fleeting for this species. What they lack in longevity, they have to make up in other ways.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种的每个个体都不尽相同，不论是肉体还是思想。§!\n
entries.en: §LMembers of this species tend to differ a lot, in both psychology and morphology.§!\n

entries.zh: §L该物种认为，苦差事最好都交给别人来做。§!\n
entries.en: §LThis species believes that whenever there is hard work that needs doing, that work is always best done by somebody else.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种大脑非常发达，他们可以轻易接受日新月异的科学进步。§!\n
entries.en: §LThis species is highly intelligent, and enjoys faster technological progress.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这一物种与土地有着难以割舍的关系，使他们成为了农业和园林的专家。§!\n
entries.en: §LThis species has a deep connection to the land, and make expert farmers and gardeners.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种在受伤之后能够快速复原，并会像狂怒的育母蜘蛛一样通过战斗来保护他们的星球。§!\n
entries.en: §LMembers of this species are physiologically resilient, and will fight like enraged brood mothers to defend their worlds.§!\n

entries.zh: §L机械体比传统的专用机器人复杂好几个数量级，但是大多数也只掌握着有限的处理能力。§!\n
entries.en: §LMechanical beings are several orders of magnitude more complex than the purpose-built automatons of old, but most possess fairly limited processing capabilities.§!\n

entries.zh: §L机器人是相对简单的机械体，他们能够处理口头命令，但自己没有拥有真正的智慧。§!\n
entries.en: §LRobots are relatively simple machines, capable of accepting verbal commands but possessing no true intelligence of their own.§!\n

entries.zh: 由于无法解释的系统错误和连绵不休的机械故障，这些古老的外星人并没有很好地适应他们新的机械躯体。然而，他们在这过程表现出了一种非同寻常的科学才能，这在之前的低级机器人中是闻所未闻的，这也许是一种处于困境之中的智慧。
entries.en: Riddled with inexplicable errors and constant breakdowns, the ancient aliens have not acclimatized well to their new mechanical bodies. Yet they display an unusual aptitude for science, previously unheard of in low-level robots - an indicator, perhaps, of the intellect trapped within.

entries.zh: 觉醒者，即使在机械躯体内，依然保持了之前的特质。浪费成性的习惯和停滞不前的生活方式是该科技高度发达的古老真菌物种衰落的原因吗？
entries.en: Even in mechanical form the Awoken have kept some of their original traits. Could wasteful habits and a sedentary lifestyle have been the downfall of this ancient race of scientifically advanced fungi?

entries.zh: §L智能人是一种更加复杂的机器人，他们往往有预先设定好的人格来更好地取悦自己的主人，他们的智能非常有限。§!\n
entries.en: §LDroids are a more complex variant of robot, often coming with pre-programmed personalities to better serve their masters as well as limited self-awareness.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这种合成人是一种比常规有机生命更具优势的精密机械。他们的中央处理器能够承载七级人工智能，以实现完全自我意识。§!\n
entries.en: §LSynthetics are very complex machines that are superior to organics in most respects. Their positronic brains are capable of supporting a class-7 artificial intelligence, making them fully self-aware.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种的成员相信资源必须得到保护以及循环利用。§!
entries.en: §LMembers of this species believe that resources must be conserved and recycled.§!

entries.zh: §R格式塔意识永远不会产生派系。§!
entries.en: §RA Gestalt Consciousness will never have Factions.§!

entries.zh: §R目前已知范围内，没有其他帝国的恒星系可以制造宣称。§!
entries.en: §RWe do not know of any empire whose systems we could claim.§!

entries.zh: §R我们无法宣称他们的恒星系。§!
entries.en: §RWe cannot claim any of their systems.§!

entries.zh: §L这个物种似乎没有节俭的概念，喜欢进行无意义的消费。§!\n
entries.en: §LMembers of this species seemingly have no concept of frugality and are prone to useless consumption.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种由半自主的个体组成，这些个体被唯一的深不可测的宏大意识所凝聚。§!\n
entries.en: §LThis species is made up of semi-autonomous individuals bound up in a single, unfathomably vast consciousness.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种由高度先进的机械组成。§!\n
entries.en: §LThis species is made up of highly advanced machines.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这一物种属于硅基生命体，靠矿物而非食物维生。它们比传统的有机生命更为坚韧，代谢缓慢，因而寿命更长却也繁殖缓慢。§!\n
entries.en: §LThis species has a silicon based biology, and consumes minerals rather than food. They are tougher than traditional organics and have slower metabolisms, making them long lived but slow to reproduce.§!\n

entries.zh: §L要是给机器人装上电钻，那什么都看起来像矿。§!\n
entries.en: §LOutfit a robot with a battery of power drills, and everything looks like a mineral deposit.§!\n

entries.zh: §L从营养疗法，就地平衡技术到单杆脱粒技术，这一整套技术工具能够增加机器人劳工的食物产出。§!\n
entries.en: §LA suite of tools, from nutrient solution diagnostics and on-site balancing to per-stalk micro-threshing, enables robotic workers to increase produce yields.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这些极其高效的处理器有助于提高所有单位的工作量和持久度。§!
entries.en: §LThese highly efficient processors increase the potential workload and endurance of all units.§!

entries.zh: §L为了驾驭愈发复杂的科学研究，我们需要一种比片面真理的三进制或者是四进制更为先进的算法逻辑。§!\n
entries.en: §LEfficiently navigating the increasingly complex frontiers of science requires new states, beyond the simple half-truths of ternary and quaternary logic.§!\n

entries.zh: §L忠诚该概念只属于有机生物。因此要把忠诚想像成即使最遥远的终端也必须满足的生理需求。§!\n
entries.en: §LLoyalty as an ideal is a distinctly organic concept. Instead, imagine loyalty as a physiological need in even the remotest of terminals.§!\n

entries.zh: §L专业的设备与行为协议可以满足一切家务需求。保证面面俱到。§!
entries.en: §LSpecialized equipment and behavior protocols for all conceivable domestic needs. Full functionality guaranteed.§!

entries.zh: §L超导性材料在单元设计中的应用将能源传输过程中的损耗降低至百分之零。§!\n
entries.en: §LThe use of superconductive materials in units has cut energy transmission losses to zero percent.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这些可折叠的劳工单位有着灵活的关节，这使他们能在运输过程中整齐地折叠成一堆，然后在现场自行组装。§!\n
entries.en: §LCollapsible labor units with flexible joints that enable them to fold neatly into stacks during transportation, then self-assemble on site.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这些高度先进的超级机器并不是为装在箱子里遨游宇宙而设计的。§!\n
entries.en: §LThese highly advanced mega-machines were not designed to traverse the universe in a box.§!\n

entries.zh: §L所有自动单位都配备了一种应用了革命性的、新的磁感应技术的存储单元，极大地强化了他们的性能。§!\n
entries.en: §LAll autonomous units are fitted with memory cells using a revolutionary new technique for magnetic induction, improving their performance significantly.§!\n

entries.zh: §L复杂的社会预测模型不仅帮助自动单元适当地模仿情绪，而且还使它能从有机体与合成体得到正面的反馈。§!\n
entries.en: §LComplex social predictive models help autonomous units to not only emulate appropriate emotions but to elicit favorable responses from organics and synthetics alike.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这些可怕的机器是以宇宙中最可怕的物种之一为蓝本创造出来的，这使他们恐怖至极。§!\n
entries.en: §LThese monstrous machines were created in the image of one of the most horrific species in the universe, and the resemblance is uncanny. §!\n

entries.zh: §L拥有镀铬钛合金制成的防护外骨骼，这些重型机器专为严酷环境而设计，只需要极少的维护。§!\n
entries.en: §LProtected by exoskeletons of chrome-plated titanium, these heavy-duty machines were designed to excel under harsh conditions and require less maintenance.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这些机器的设计完全没有考虑到使用年限的问题，因此故障频发。它们经常需要进行维护。§!\n
entries.en: §LThese machines were designed with a complete disregard for longevity and are prone to malfunction. They will require frequent maintenance.§!\n

entries.zh: §L复杂的自我学习的算法，能够刺激单元的神经节点快速进化。§!\n
entries.en: §LSophisticated, self-learning algorithms that stimulate the rapid evolution of a unit's neural clusters.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这一系列的机器原本是为了特定的目的而设计，自主思考能力并不在其原本的设计范围内，而改造也只能做到一定程度。§!\n
entries.en: §LDesigned to meet the very specific needs of their creators, this line of machines were never intended to have the capacity for higher reasoning, and retrofitting will only get them so far.§!\n

entries.zh: §L流线型生产与模块化设计使单位可以高效率地进行量产。§!\n
entries.en: §LStreamlined production cycles and modular designs allow for unit mass-production at an unprecedented rate.§!\n

entries.zh: §L每一个新单元都以前所未有地追求细节精心制作。这是一个工程和艺术的奇迹，但缺乏效率。§!\n
entries.en: §LEach new unit is crafted with unparalleled attention to detail. A marvel of engineering and art, but not very efficient.§!\n

entries.zh: §L单元生产过程被优化为尽可能节约成本，使用回收的原料，以及从上一世代继承下来的部件。§!\n
entries.en: §LUnit manufacturing has been optimized to be as cost-effective as possible, using recycled materials, and components inherited from previous generations.§!\n

entries.zh: §L以质量无价为原则而设计，这些一流的单位价格不菲，但是闪亮亮。§!\n
entries.en: §LDesigned after the principle that you cannot put a price on quality, these first-rate units are costly, but shiny.§!\n

entries.zh: §L单元能够不断地通过内部广播系统把公共服务公告与其他有用信息汇成一股巨流。§!\n
entries.en: §LUnits are constantly uplinked to a central stream of public service announcements and other useful information that they pass along via internal broadcasting systems.§!\n

entries.zh: §L这个物种在经历了一场核子天启后最终幸存了下来。他们在极端恶劣环境下的生存能力不容小觑。§!
entries.en: §LThis species has survived the horrors of a nuclear apocalypse. Their capacity for thriving in the most inhospitable of circumstances should not be underestimated.§!

entries.zh: §L这些机械是一场毁灭性核灾难的唯一幸存者，它们展现出对最严酷环境无可比拟的抵抗力。§!
entries.en: §LThese machines, the solitary survivors of an annihilating nuclear disaster, exhibit unparalleled resilience in the harshest environments.§!

entries.zh: §L这个物种由于某些方面的认知，从而导致其特别注重历史研究以及集体团结。§!
entries.en: §LCertain aspects of this species' cognition make it predisposed toward historical precedence and the value of collective unity.§!

entries.zh: §L虽然并非天生多疑，这个物种的个体却常常发生社会纠纷。§!
entries.en: §LWhile not inherently distrustful, members of this species are often socially combative.§!

entries.zh: §L这一物种在代谢过程中会有规律地排放有工业价值的气体。§!
entries.en: §LThe metabolic processes of this species cause regular venting of gases useful to industry.§!

entries.zh: 每$pop_group_unit$作为奴隶或更高工作标准的£pop£§H人口§!每月生产0.01£exotic_gases£§Y$exotic_gases$§!。
entries.en: Every $pop_group_unit$ £pop£ §HPops§! working as a slave or better produces 0.01 £exotic_gases£ §Y$exotic_gases$§! per month.

entries.zh: §L这一物种的体表布满了闪闪发光的晶体和宝石，间或剥落而下。§!
entries.en: §LThe outermost layer of this species is studded with sparkling crystals and gemstones that occasionally flake off.§!

entries.zh: 每$pop_group_unit$作为奴隶或更高工作标准的£pop£§H人口§!每月生产0.01£rare_crystals£§Y$rare_crystals$§!。
entries.en: Every $pop_group_unit$ £pop£ §HPops§! working as a slave or better produces 0.01 £rare_crystals£ §Y$rare_crystals$§! per month.

entries.zh: §L这一物种产生的高度浓缩的臭迹并不稳定，其中包含难以置信的能量。§!
entries.en: §LThe highly compressed spoor created by this species is unstable and contains an unbelievable amount of power.§!

entries.zh: 每$pop_group_unit$作为奴隶或更高工作标准的£pop£§H人口§!每月生产0.01£volatile_motes£§Y$volatile_motes$§!。
entries.en: Every $pop_group_unit$ £pop£ §HPops§! working as a slave or better produces 0.01 £volatile_motes£ §Y$volatile_motes$§! per month.

entries.zh: §L该物种的个体易于管理和组织。他们更加友善且乐于合作。§!
entries.en: §LMembers of this species are easy to manage and organize. They tend to be cooperative and amicable.§!

entries.zh: §L桀骜不驯的物种难以组织和管理。他们不喜欢被人告知该干什么，并且总是在无休止地争吵和质问。§!
entries.en: §LUnruly species are difficult to manage and organize. They do not like being told what to do, and are often quarrelsome or questioning.§!

entries.zh: §L高度批次化的AI处理使这些单位得以在极大规模的集群行动时只有最小的效率损失。§!
entries.en: §LExtensively batched AI processes allow these units to scale greatly in numbers with minimal loss of efficiency.§!

entries.zh: §L每个个体单位均会发送和接收大量的重复数据，使得各中央处理单元附属的单位数量增加时带来的延迟指数增长。§!
entries.en: §LEach individual unit sends and receives a large amount of largely duplicate data, causing exponential lag as the number of units attached to each central processing hub increases.§!

entries.zh: §L预测算法可以实现最大的优化。市场上无穷小的波动，无论是流通率、库存情况、有机客户的情绪反应都会被纳入考量。§!
entries.en: §LPredictive algorithms allow for maximum optimization. Infinitesimal market fluctuations in currency rates, stock availability, and the emotional response of organic partners are accounted for.§!

entries.zh: §L这一物种的代谢过程被进行了基因调控，会排放有工业价值的气体。§!
entries.en: §LThe metabolic processes of this species have been genetically engineered to produce gases useful to industry.§!

entries.zh: §L通过先进的基因工程，该物种的体表长满了由晶体和宝石构成的便于收割的鳞屑。§!
entries.en: §LThrough advanced genetic engineering, the outermost layer of this species forms scales studded with crystals and gemstones ripe for harvest.§!

entries.zh: §L对基因编码的调控使得该物种可以产出高价值的复合排出物。通过合理运用这些物质可以释放出极高的能量。§!
entries.en: §LTweaks to their genetic code have caused this species to produce highly compressed spoor. When properly utilized, this material releases an exceptional amount of power.§!

entries.zh: §L在克隆仓内人工助长，该物种的自然繁衍能力受到了负面的影响。§!
entries.en: §LArtificially grown in cloning vats, the natural reproductive abilities of this species have been negatively impacted.§!

entries.zh: §L该物种被编辑出极高的生产矿物的能力。§!\n
entries.en: §LThis species has been engineered to be especially mineral-rich.§!\n

entries.zh: §L该物种被编辑为极其熟于与机械打交道。§!
entries.en: §LThis species has been engineered to have an incredible knack at working with machinery.§!

entries.zh: §L该物种拥有嫁接自星际龙族的基因物质。他们身上脱落的鳞片可以被回收为有用的合金。§!
entries.en: §LThis species has the genetic material from a stellar dragon spliced into its DNA. As such, they shed scales which can be recycled into useful alloys.§!

entries.zh: §L该物种拥有嫁接自虚空孳孽的基因物质。他们能吸收宇宙射线存活，并能耐受严酷的环境。§!
entries.en: §LThis species has the genetic material from the Voidspawn spliced into its DNA. Subsisting off cosmic radiation, they are highly resistant to hostile environments.§!

entries.zh: §L该物种拥有嫁接自缇扬奇族母的基因物质。他们能进行快速无性繁殖，并长出预想外的附肢。§!
entries.en: §LThis species has added genetic material from the Tiyanki Matriarch into their DNA sequence. This has granted them rapid asexual reproduction, as well as a few unexpected tentacles.§!

entries.zh: §L该物种在危机四伏的环境中成长，通过繁殖得比对手更多而得以幸存。§!
entries.en: §LThis species grew up in hostile conditions where outbreeding your rivals was the key to survival.§!

§L这个物种的成员对冲突的严峻极其敏感，由此产生的压力取代了更原始的冲动。§!
entries.en: §LMembers of this species are extremely sensitive to the rigors of conflict with the resulting stress taking over the more primal urges.§!

§L这一物种的领袖仿佛生来便带着诅咒一般，更加笨拙，更容易出意外或犯错误。§!
entries.en: §LLeaders from this species seem clumsier and more prone to accidents or vices than average, as if cursed from birth.§!

entries.zh: §L气候偏好由基因决定的，通过长期进化或人工操纵形成。§!
entries.en: §LClimate preference is determined at the genetic level, by eons of evolution or skillful manipulation.§!

entries.zh: §L气候偏好由基因决定的，通过长期进化或人工操纵形成。§!
entries.en: §LClimate preference is determined at the genetic level, by eons of evolution or skillful manipulation.§!

entries.zh: §L气候偏好由亿万年来的进化、设计，或是人工基因操纵所决定。§!
entries.en: §LClimate preference is determined by eons of evolution, design, or skillful genetic manipulation.§!

entries.zh: §L气候偏好是在基因层面决定的，在当下这个情况，是因为一场事故。§!
entries.en: §LClimate preference is determined at the genetic level, and in this case, by accident.§!

entries.zh: §L气候偏好是由设计所决定的。§!
这位领袖乐意接受更加优越的新方法或新思想。
entries.en: This leader is quick to adopt new methods and ideas that prove superior.

entries.zh: 这位领袖很固执，即便新方法或新思维更加优越，也不太愿意接受。
entries.en: This leader is stubborn and slow to accept new methods and ideas, even if they have proven superior.

entries.zh: 这位领袖的身躯健康状况良好且恢复能力强，延长了预期寿命。
entries.en: This leader is resilient and in excellent physical condition, increasing their life expectancy.

entries.zh: 这位领袖长期利用有损健康的药物来缓解压力，导致寿命减少。
entries.en: This leader has fallen to substance abuse to cope with stress, which has had a detrimental effect on their physical health.
This leader is particularly eager for an assignment.

entries.zh: 这名领袖的发展和能力似乎达到了一个停滞阶段。
entries.en: The personal development and skills of this leader seem to have plateaued.

entries.zh: 这位领袖不受时间流逝的影响，不会因衰老而去世。
entries.en: This leader is unaffected by time and will not die from old age.

entries.zh: 这位领袖曾是一名空战王牌，懂得如何利用舰载机的速度和机动性来获取战斗优势。
entries.en: A former space ace, this leader excels at utilizing the speed and maneuverability of Strike Craft squadrons.

entries.zh: 这位领袖懂得如何出其不意，攻其不备，利用战略战术误导来取得优势。
entries.en: This leader fights deviously, relying on misdirection and surprise to get the better of the enemy.

entries.zh: 这位领袖曾经精通后勤领域，并且知道如何管理物资以降低维护成本。
entries.en: This leader has mastered the field of logistics, and knows how to manage supplies to keep upkeep costs down.

entries.zh: 这位领袖擅长舰队组织，具备必要的微观管理能力，可以有效管理庞大的舰队。
entries.en: This leader is an expert at organization, having the necessary micromanagement skills to command very large starship formations.

entries.zh: 这位领袖紧张且焦虑，在指挥庞大的舰队时很容易因压力而崩溃。
entries.en: This leader is nervous and apprehensive, and is easily overwhelmed commanding large formations of starships.

entries.zh: 这位领袖是一名天才工程师，具有在任务过程中组织和监管舰船维修的知识和技能。
entries.en: This leader is a natural engineer, having the knowledge and skills to organize and oversee starship repairs while on missions.

entries.zh: 这位领袖因颇具攻击性而声名远扬，喜欢通过舰队武器投送多重的炮火洗礼来压垮敌军。
entries.en: This leader is notoriously aggressive, overwhelming the enemy with numerous barrages from their fleet's weapons.

entries.zh: 这位领袖是一名谨慎的指挥官，他的战斗风格非常保守，但是其指挥下的舰船在战斗中能够互相支援。
entries.en: This leader is a cautious commander, avoiding unnecessary risks and taking care to always maintain formations in which fleet units can mutually support each other against the enemy.

entries.zh: 这位领袖宁可战死也不退缩。
entries.en: This leader would prefer to fight to the death than admit defeat.

entries.zh: 这位领袖认为，无论是怎样的太空战役，速度总是决胜的关键。
entries.en: This leader believes that speed and rapid maneuvers are the keys to success in any space engagement.

entries.zh: 这位领袖对工作没有干劲，缺乏积极性。
entries.en: This leader is slow and indolent, performing duties with little energy or initiative.

entries.zh: 这位领袖关心最小化损失，避免士兵和非战斗人员的不必要伤亡。
entries.en: This leader is concerned with minimizing loss and avoiding unnecessary deaths among soldiers and non-combatants.

entries.zh: 这位领袖擅长防守，知道如何最有效安排地面军团、运用防御工事，会让入侵的敌人吃尽苦头。
entries.en: This leader is an expert defender, knowing how best to deploy ground units and utilize fortifications to make planetary invasions as difficult as possible for the enemy.

entries.zh: 这位领袖擅长攻打行星，知道如何从空中向敌方行星发动攻击最有效率。
entries.en: This leader has mastered the art of planetary invasions, knowing how to most effectively storm an enemy planet from space.

entries.zh: 这位领袖毫不留情，只会用最严酷的手段对待敌人。
entries.en: This leader is ruthless, giving no quarter to the enemy.

entries.zh: 这位领袖永远战斗在最前线，身先士卒，鼓舞士气，置危险于不顾。
entries.en: This leader always joins the front line, lifting the spirits of the troops despite the risks involved.

entries.zh: 这位陆军将领总在大后方遥控战局，让前线将士的士气大减。
entries.en: This leader commands from the rear, which demoralizes front-line troops.

entries.zh: 这位领袖似乎总是可以从意想不到的地方获取补给物资，从而降低地面部队的维护费。
entries.en: This leader can seemingly conjure up supplies from nowhere, decreasing the upkeep costs of ground forces.

entries.zh: 这位领袖对效率的追求令人胆寒，为达目的总是尽最大可能榨取奴隶。
entries.en: This leader is infamous for their ruthless pursuit of efficiency, and is capable of getting the most out of slave labor.

entries.zh: 这位领袖是一名退伍老兵，在自己的星域对陆军有所优待。
entries.en: A veteran, this leader gives the army preferential treatment in their sector.

entries.zh: 这位领袖曾是退伍海军军官，在其管理下积极地支援舰队建设。
entries.en: A former fleet officer, this leader actively supports shipyards under their administration.

entries.zh: 这位主管对建筑和建筑技术有浓厚的兴趣。
entries.en: This leader cultivates a strong interest in architecture and construction techniques.

entries.zh: 该领袖在农业区里长大，对优化产量有浓厚兴趣。
entries.en: Raised in a farming zone, this leader is interested in optimizing yields.

entries.zh: 这位领袖对科学研究充满兴趣，他试图培养大众对科学的好奇心。
entries.en: This leader is naturally interested in the sciences and seeks to foster a curiosity about the natural world in their subjects.

entries.zh: 这位领袖有地形塑造流程方面的尖端知识和成本控制技术。
entries.en: This leader has expertise in cutting edge geo-sculpting processes and cost-saving techniques.

entries.zh: 这位领袖擅长政府间外交和建立共识。
entries.en: This leader excels at inter-government diplomacy and consensus building.

entries.zh: 这位领袖习惯彻底地反复研究他们尚还不能掌控的陌生现象。
entries.en: This leader is thorough in their examinations of unknown phenomena.

entries.zh: 这位领袖总是有突如其来的灵感。
entries.en: This leader is prone to sudden bursts of inspiration.

entries.zh: 这位科学家并不像其他人那样谨小慎微。
entries.en: This leader is perhaps less meticulous than others.

entries.zh: 这位领袖生来注定要在星际间漫游。
entries.en: This leader was born to roam the stars.
