这位领袖擅长研究考古领域的外星人的文物和建筑遗迹。
entries.en: This leader excels at the study of alien artifacts and structural remnants in the field.

entries.zh: 这位领袖不喜欢和其他人合作。
entries.en: This leader is unwilling to collaborate with others.

entries.zh: 这位科学家对科学研究的热情非同寻常。
entries.en: This leader pursues their research with unusual fervor.

entries.zh: 这位领袖自我研制了一副简单的神经网络来协助他进行科研。
entries.en: This leader has created a simple neural network to help with data processing tasks.

entries.zh: 这位领袖自行研制了一副复合神经网络来协助他决策判断和自我检索。
entries.en: This leader has created a complex neural network capable of independent decision-making and even introspection.

entries.zh: 这位领袖长期以来致力于研究材料学，是材料学领域的专家。
entries.en: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Materials.

entries.zh: 这位领袖经过数年学习，已被公认为是动力学领域的专家。
entries.en: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Propulsion.

entries.zh: 经过多年的潜心研究，这位领袖成为了宇航技术领域首屈一指的专家。
entries.en: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Voidcraft.

entries.zh: 这位领袖长期以来致力于研究工业，是工业领域的专家。
entries.en: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Industry.

entries.zh: 经过多年的潜心研究，这位领袖成为了力场操控领域首屈一指的专家。
entries.en: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Field Manipulation.

entries.zh: 经过多年的潜心研究，这位领袖成为了粒子领域首屈一指的专家。
entries.en: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Particles.

entries.zh: 经过多年的潜心研究，这位领袖成为了形而上学领域首屈一指的专家。
entries.en: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Metaphysics.

entries.zh: 经过多年的潜心研究，这位领袖成为了灵能领域首屈一指的专家。
entries.en: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Psionics.

entries.zh: 经过多年的潜心研究，这位领袖成为了计算技术领域首屈一指的专家。
entries.en: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Computing.

entries.zh: 经过多年的潜心研究，这位领袖成为了殖民新世界领域首屈一指的专家。
entries.en: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert on settling on New Worlds.

entries.zh: 经过多年的潜心研究，这位领袖成为了治国领域首屈一指的专家。
entries.en: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Statecraft.

entries.zh: 经过多年的潜心研究，这位领袖成为了生物学领域首屈一指的专家。
entries.en: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Biology.

entries.zh: 经过多年的潜心研究，这位领袖成为了军事理论领域首屈一指的专家。
entries.en: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Military Theory.

entries.zh: 这位领袖来自策展人势力。他对科技和探索的知识是无可匹敌的。
entries.en: This leader hails from the Curator Order. Their understanding of technology and exploration is unmatched.

entries.zh: 该节点整合了策展人城邦的基本知识原理。
entries.en: This node has assimilated the fundamental teachings of the Curator Enclave.

entries.zh: 毛巾对一个星际漫游者来说是最有用的东西。
entries.en: A towel has immense psychological value.

entries.zh: 没有什么硬件问题是自由使用靴子不能解决的。
entries.en: There is no such thing as a hardware problem that liberal use of the boot will not fix.

entries.zh: 这位领袖专注于推动护卫舰的建造。
entries.en: This leader is intent on promoting the construction of Corvettes.

entries.zh: 这位领袖专注于推动驱逐舰的建造。
entries.en: This leader is intent on promoting the construction of Destroyers.

entries.zh: 这位领袖专注于推动巡洋舰的建造。
entries.en: This leader is intent on promoting the construction of Cruisers.

entries.zh: 这位领袖专注于推动战列舰的建造。
entries.en: This leader is intent on promoting the construction of Battleships.

entries.zh: 这位领袖拥有独特魅力，能让新兵争先恐后地为帝国效力。
entries.en: This leader is particularly charismatic, and fresh recruits are practically lining up to serve their nation.

entries.zh: 这位领袖是从普通士兵一步步晋升上来的。
entries.en: This leader rose through the ranks of military command.

entries.zh: 这位领袖深知利用防御站来保卫领土的价值。
entries.en: This ruler understands the value in using military stations to secure territory.

entries.zh: 这位领袖深知合理构建补给链的重要性。
entries.en: This leader is well aware of the importance of properly-structured supply chains.

entries.zh: 这位领袖热衷于发展战斗科技，推动舰船建造。
entries.en: This leader is enthusiastic about advancements in military technology and ship construction.
This leader does not shy away from conflict.

entries.zh: 这位领袖有一颗建筑师的心，致力于提高建造效率。
entries.en: This leader is an architect at heart, investing in more efficient construction practices.

entries.zh: 这位领袖渴望开拓遥远的星球。
entries.en: This leader is eager to reign over distant stars.

entries.zh: 这位领袖希望按自己的意愿重塑世界。
entries.en: This leader seeks to remake worlds in their image.

entries.zh: 这位领袖的梦想是星辰大海。
entries.en: This leader reaches for the stars.

entries.zh: 这位领袖密切关注矿业产出的提升。
entries.en: This leader has a firm focus on increasing mining output.

entries.zh: 这位领袖洞察力异常敏锐，寻常人眼中只是古怪或无用的人，他能够发现其中的天才。
entries.en: This leader is considered to be unusually perceptive, spotting talent where others see only eccentricity or incompetence.

entries.zh: 这位领袖在错综复杂的行政体系中不动如山。
entries.en: This leader is firmly entrenched in the labyrinthine web that makes up the political machine.

entries.zh: 这位领袖魅力非凡，能够轻松推行自己的政策。
entries.en: This leader is exceptionally charismatic, enforcing their will with ease.

entries.zh: 这位领袖真诚为人民谋福祉。
entries.en: This leader appears to genuinely care about their subjects.

entries.zh: 基于效率回馈循环和行为-反应分析使该单元在预测产出方面表现更佳。
entries.en: Efficient feedback loops and action-reaction analysis make this unit far better at predicting outcomes.

entries.zh: 这位领袖致力于将帝国的疆域拓展向更遥远的群星。
entries.en: This leader is driven to push the empire's reach ever further into the stars.

entries.zh: 这位领袖擅长为迅速增长的人口获取关键资源。
entries.en: This leader excels in acquiring vital resources for a burgeoning population.

entries.zh: 这位领袖是一位精明的经济学家，能够实现经济潜力的最大化。
entries.en: This leader is a shrewd economist, capable of maximizing financial potential.

entries.zh: 这位领袖深知矿物开采对于一个帝国的重要性。
entries.en: This leader recognizes just how vital the exploitation of offworld resources is for a star nation.

entries.zh: 这位领袖有着无尽的好奇心，认为太空探索重于一切。
entries.en: This leader is known for their insatiable curiosity, valuing space exploration above all else.

entries.zh: 这位领袖是监督并指挥机械帝国的核心智能。
entries.en: This leader is the core intelligence that oversees and directs all actions in a Machine Empire.

entries.zh: 这位领袖的编程格外灵活，使其可以迅速适应更加高效的新方法和新程序。
entries.en: This leader has unusually flexible programming, and is capable of quickly adapting new methods and procedures if they produce superior results.

entries.zh: 这位领袖的编程特别死板，很少允许行为变化，即使这种变化能改善效率。
entries.en: This leader has particularly rigid programming that only rarely permits behavioral modifications, even when such changes would improve efficiency.

entries.zh: 这位领袖最近才被升级为足够自立的状态来担任指挥职位。
entries.en: This leader was only recently upgraded to a sufficiently autonomous state to allow for command positions.

entries.zh: 这位领袖对战争机器的设计有着浓厚的兴趣，并持续不断地改进我们已有的型号。
entries.en: This leader has an unusual interest in warbot design, and is constantly improving and tinkering with our existing models.

entries.zh: 为了提高星舰的建造效率，这个领袖经常在次级记忆核心上运行理论模型。
entries.en: This leader constantly runs theoretical models on a secondary memory core for the purpose of improving starship construction efficiency.

entries.zh: 这位领袖掌握了迅速而有效地将外星地貌转变为停车场的艺术。
entries.en: This leader has mastered the art of quickly and efficiently transforming alien terrain into a parking lot.

entries.zh: 这位领袖将其大部分处理能力用于分析自然科学，并鼓励他人也进行研究。
entries.en: This leader devotes an unusually large percentage of its processor power towards analyzing the natural sciences and promoting their study by others.

entries.zh: 这位领袖非常擅长从损坏或故障的战争机器上调拨零件来让其他战争机器维持运作。
entries.en: This leader is very adept at cannibalizing parts from fallen or malfunctioning warbots to keep others running longer.

entries.zh: 这位领袖沉迷于研究有机生命脆弱的意志，以及如何创造性地利用心理战术来在战场上击溃敌人的士气。
entries.en: This leader is fascinated by the fragile minds of organics, and how they can most efficiently be broken through the creative use of terror tactics on the battlefield.

entries.zh: 这位领袖因道德核心的不稳定，而经常对敌人的伤亡感到羞愧与悔恨。
entries.en: This leader frequently suffers intense bouts of shame and regret over enemy casualties due to an erratic morality core.

entries.zh: 这位领袖在持续进行次级维护循环，一丝不苟地维护舰队中的所有舰船，并降低其后勤花费。
entries.en: This leader is constantly engaged in a secondary maintenance loop, taking meticulous care of all the ships in its fleet and reducing their logistical costs.

entries.zh: 这位领袖的代码库非常不稳定，导致有时会做出战战兢兢甚至不合逻辑的行为。
entries.en: This leader suffers from an unstable code base, resulting in jittery and sometimes illogical behavior.

entries.zh: 这位领袖最大的欲望就是将整个宇宙编纂成册。
entries.en: This leader can conceive of no greater calling than to catalog the entirety of the universe.

entries.zh: 哨兵舰队指挥官对索林原虫的生理构造及其战术了如指掌。
entries.en: Sentinel fleet commanders possess detailed knowledge of Prethoryn anatomy and tactics.

entries.zh: 控制索林原虫舰队的格式塔意识具有处理复杂多任务的能力。
entries.en: The gestalt consciousness that controls the actions of Prethoryn fleets has proven capable of tremendous multi-tasking.

entries.zh: 基于该舰队意识行动的索林原虫，彼此之间有着非比寻常的共鸣。他们的开火纪律得到极大改善，射速也随之提高。
entries.en: The Prethoryn creatures operating under this fleet consciousness have managed to attain an unusual level of affinity to one another. Their firing discipline has greatly improved, leading to a higher rate of fire.

entries.zh: 这支舰队的捕猎本能让其麾下的索林原虫陷入狂躁。对战争的渴求推动着他们勇往直前。
entries.en: The hunting instincts of this fleet consciousness has driven the Prethoryn creatures under its dominion into a frenzy. Their eagerness for battle drives them ever forward.

entries.zh: 这些异次元舰队已经学会了如何令他们的船只变得虚无，大大地提升了回避能力。
entries.en: Some extradimensional fleet lords have learned to use the ethereal nature of their vessels to greatly enhance their evasive capabilities in combat.

entries.zh: 不知道为什么，这些异次元舰队的航迹若隐若现，他们在以一个更快的速度进行亚光速航行。
entries.en: For unknown reasons, the vessels under the command of this extradimensional fleet lord seem to rapidly stutter in and out of existence as they move, which has the effect of increasing their sublight speeds.

entries.zh: §L一个强大的能起引导作用的力量，对于任何文明的成功都是至关重要的——否则国家将陷入无政府与混乱。领导民众走向生产力最高的道路是国家的职责。§!\n
entries.en: §LA strong, guiding hand is essential to the success of any civilization - the alternative would be anarchy and chaos. It is the duty of the state to steer its citizens towards the paths that are the most productive.§!\n

entries.zh: §L同一个声音，同一个权力，同一个国家。所有的民众，都有着庄严的义务去服从明智的少数人。而这些少数人承担了领导民众的巨大责任。§!\n
entries.en: §LA single voice, a single throne, a single state. It is the solemn duty of the masses to obey those enlightened few who have been charged with the great responsibility of leadership.§!\n

entries.zh: §L平等的社会中所有个体都应当能通过足够努力的工作获得更高的地位。任何拒绝信奉其成员应当平等的社会，不仅严重缺乏公正，更是彻底误入歧途。§!\n
entries.en: §LAny society that does not embrace equality between its members - where an individual can rise to any position with enough hard work - is not only deeply unfair, but ultimately counterproductive.§!\n

entries.zh: §L时刻警惕那些会成为独裁者的人，在他们错误的假定中，个人的欲望与事项凌驾于他们的追随者之上。一个不重视其所有成员需求和利益的社会不是社会——而是一个犯罪组织。§!\n
entries.en: §LBeware always those who would be despots, under the false presumption that their desires and agendas are somehow more imperative than those of their fellows. A society that does not see to the needs and rights of all of its members is not a society - it is a crime.§!\n

entries.zh: §L我们已经在冒着巨大的风险探索星海，任何不解与未知都被猜忌所巨大化。对于异族生物的信任是毫无意义的，跨物种与意识形态的差异将导致宇宙社会不再是个童话里的森林。§!\n
entries.en: §LThe stakes could not be higher as we reach into the vast uncharted expanses of the galaxy, for we are gambling with the very survival of our species! Never trust the alien; its false smile hides an unknowable mind...§!\n

entries.zh: §L一切来自异星人的影响都必须毫不留情地抹除干净。唯有保持纯净，坚守真我，对哺育了我们文明的世界保持忠诚，才能确保我们免受异种邪恶阴谋的腐蚀。纵然实力与地位凌驾于异星人之上，亦不足以让我们高枕无忧……§!\n
entries.en: §LAny alien influence must be ruthlessly quashed. Only by staying pure, and true to ourselves and the planet that gave us life can we guard against insidious Xeno plots. Even mastery over the Alien might not be enough to guarantee our own safety...§!\n

entries.zh: §L我们的内心中都存在着一份对于未知的好奇心，我们愿意与任何物种建立交流，来让自己知道得更多，了解得更多。§!\n
entries.en: §LThere exists, in all of us, a deep-seated fascination for the unknown. An adventurous spirit that rejects the familiar and glories in the unfamiliar, whatever - or whomever - it may be.§!\n

entries.zh: §L如果在我们的社会中存在一个绝对的道德法则，那就是探索深空与外星人，并与他们融为一体。星海漫漫，但我们从不孤独。§!\n
entries.en: §LIf there ever was such a thing as an absolute moral imperative, it would be to explore the cosmos and embrace all within it. We were never meant to journey alone.§!\n

entries.zh: §L我们相信唯一的真正的美德是勇气和纪律，武装力量能够更好地保护自己，胜过任何脆弱的约定与诺言。§!\n
entries.en: §LThe only true virtues are courage and discipline, and channeled properly they can overcome any obstacle. Therein lies true strength; force withheld, a promise made.§!\n

entries.zh: §L在这个无助的深空中，没有什么比武力更具备话语权。这个宇宙不是一个摇篮，也没有任何的道德约束。§!\n
entries.en: §LThe ability to project force is of paramount importance. The only way to preserve our way of life is to make sure everyone shares it; willingly or not...§!\n

entries.zh: §L我们认为任何事情都可以被和平地解决，冲突带来的结果是破坏性的，甚至会破坏我们互相争夺的东西。§!\n
entries.en: §LConflict as a means to an end is a ridiculous concept. It is by nature destructive, destroying what was to be obtained or giving room to grow that which was to be destroyed.§!\n

entries.zh: §L作为文明的化身，我们认为武力无法解决任何问题，战争只能带来痛苦与死亡，所有人都会因此付出巨大而无谓的代价。§!\n
entries.en: §LAs civilized beings, the end of all armed conflict should be our primary concern. War is an evolutionary dead end, as futile as it is wasteful.§!\n

entries.zh: §L有人认为我们应当记住我们是如何的藐小，我们的生命在巨大而冷漠的宇宙中是如何的没有意义……这是多么的不可理喻！我们能够所知的唯一真相就是我们的存在。宇宙——无论它拥有多少浮于表面的称颂——也不过是我们偶然分享的梦境而已。§!\n
entries.en: §LThere are those who think it behooves us to remember how tiny we are, how pointless our lives are in this vast uncaring universe... What nonsense! The only truth we can ever know is that of our own existence. The universe - in all its apparent glory - is but a dream we all happen to share.§!\n

entries.zh: §L我们的科学已经证明了意识乃现实之父。我们耐心的审视那些用其他的世界观欺骗自己的人，他们做着孩童般幼稚的努力，翻弄着他们的一块块“实在的物质”。§!\n
entries.en: §LOur science has proved that Consciousness begets reality. We regard with patience the childlike efforts of those who delude themselves it is the other way around, as they play with their blocks of "hard matter."§!\n

entries.zh: §L我们认为在一个物种接触太空时就必须抛开所有幼稚的事物，比如宗教与神明这种虚幻的东西。现实是残酷而无情的，我们坚定信心，通过对科学的坚定不移的追求来切实维护族群的生存空间。§!\n
entries.en: §LAs we reach for the stars, we must put away childish things; gods, spirits and other phantasms of the brain. Reality is cruel and unforgiving, yet we must steel ourselves and secure the survival of our race through the unflinching pursuit of science and technology.§!\n

entries.zh: §L尽管这很残酷，但是我们必须成长起来，抛弃我们过时的道德观念。没有所谓的“神圣的思维火花”赋予生命体某种特殊的价值。除了我们选择授予的，没有任何东西拥有内在的独一无二的价值。让我们拥抱确信的自由，然后在所有的方面都达到最高的效率！§!\n
entries.en: §LAlthough it hurts, we must grow up and put aside our outdated notions of morality. There is no "divine spark" granting special value to a living mind. No object has any intrinsic value apart from what we choose to grant it. Let us embrace the freedom of certitude, and achieve maximum efficiency in all things!§!\n

entries.zh: §L他们的思想是混杂的，任何倾向都可能存在于他们的社会中。§!
entries.en: §LThe neutral mind is the free mind, open to all possibilities...§!
